Come help me carry it, please!?
Cloth is way heavier than it looks!
m900405.ミスリアさん、キャラットさん。\nもしやそれが、神獣麒麟の贈り物で作った装備です:
Mithria, Carat.
Could it be that you've made equipment
from the Divine Beast Qilin's gift?
m900405.世界を守るために生まれたのに戦えず、\n平和を望むのに、兵器としての使命に抗えず:
Born to protect the world, yet unable to fight,
desiring peace, yet unable to defy its duty as a weapon……
m900405.他の神獣と同じく「神の威光」によって、\n一定周期で兵を遠方に転移させてくるはず:
Like the other Divine Beasts, it will likely use its "Divine Radiance"
to teleport troops from afar at regular intervals.
Be sure to deploy your elite units in separate squads.
m900405.伝承によれば、神獣麒麟の雷は、\nそれを受けた者の攻撃の力だけでなく、\n防護の:
According to legend, the Qilin's lightning
does not just bind the target's attacking power,
but their defensive power as well.
m900405.偉大な神獣の意志を継ぎにきたのだもの。\nふふっ、誰だって緊張するものよ。:
You are here to inherit the will of a great Divine Beast.
Heh, anyone would be nervous in that situation.
m900405.大丈夫です。\n王子さまが優しくて、皆の幸せを願っているって、\nわたしたち全員:
It's alright.
We all know how kind the Prince is, and how he wishes for everyone's happiness.
m900405.布……？ わぁっ、すごい綺麗な反物なのです。: Cloth……? Oh my, it's a truly beautiful bolt of fabric.
m900405.幻獣麒麟が認めた王子を、\n神獣麒麟も認めてくれたようね。:
It seems the Divine Beast Qilin has accepted the Prince
as the Phantom Beast Qilin did.
m900405.心正しき、勇者。\n……誰よりお人好しな王子さまなら、\n神獣麒麟も認めてくれる:
A righteous hero.
……If anyone, it would be our kind-hearted Prince.
Surely the Divine Beast Qilin will acknowledge him?
m900405.戦いを嫌いながら、\n自身が攻撃された時には暴走し、\n災禍をもたらしてしまうよ:
That is because, while it despises war,
it goes into a rampage when attacked,
bringing calamity upon the land.
m900405.戦の勝利や悪の討伐ならともかく、\n泰平の世を任せられるなんてねぇ……。:
If it were about winning a war or defeating evil, that's one thing,
but to entrust a peaceful age to him…….
m900405.暴走してしまった神獣麒麟は、\n心正しき勇者との戦いによって、\nその怒りを鎮め:
It is written that a Divine Beast Qilin that went berserk
had its fury calmed by battling a righteous hero.
m900405.泰平の世を象徴し、殺生を嫌う穏やかな幻獣麒麟。\nそれをモデルに編み上げられた神:
The Phantom Beast Qilin, a gentle creature that abhors killing and symbolizes a peaceful age.
The Divine Beast Qilin, crafted in its image, was likewise
an imperfect weapon that detested war.
m900405.王子が、泰平の世をもたらす器だと\n受け入れてくれたのかしら……？:
Has it accepted the Prince as one capable
of bringing an era of peace……?
m900405.王子さまならきっと大丈夫なのです。\nでも、ひとりで抱え込み過ぎちゃだめですよ？:
I'm sure the Prince will be fine.
But you mustn't try to carry everything on your own, okay?
m900405.王子は仲間と共に歩む者、だからね。\n平和な世界は、みんなで一緒に作っていこう。:
The Prince is someone who walks alongside his companions.
Let's build a peaceful world together, all of us.
m900405.確かに、王子が相手なら、\n神獣麒麟も安心して眠れそうだ。:
Indeed, if the Prince is the one facing it,
the Divine Beast Qilin might finally be able to sleep peacefully.
m900405.神獣は神々の兵器……。\n戦いを避けるなら、確かに兵器としては不完全かな。:
Divine Beasts are the weapons of the gods…….
If it avoids battle, it certainly is an incomplete weapon.
m900405.神獣麒麟が攻撃形態となるのは、\nほんの少しでも傷を負った時。\n可能な限り直接:
The Divine Beast Qilin enters its attack form
the moment it sustains even the slightest injury.
It is best to avoid direct attacks whenever possible.
m900405.神獣麒麟の加護が逆転したのよ。\n周囲一帯に、麒麟のもたらす災禍が満ちていくわ！:
The Divine Beast Qilin's blessing has turned against us.
The calamity it brings is spreading across the entire area!
m900405.神獣麒麟の暴走を鎮めた逸話が、ひとつあるわ。: There is a legend of how the Divine Beast Qilin's rampage was once quelled.
m900405.華の国で、神獣麒麟が\n封印を解いてしまったようで……。:
It seems the Divine Beast Qilin in the Land of Flowers
has broken its seal…….
m900405.迷子になってる神獣麒麟さんを、\nみんなで助けにいきましょう。\n王子さまならき:
Let's all go help the lost Divine Beast Qilin.
Your Highness will surely be able to reassure it♪
m900405.防具ではあるけど、\n同時に晴れ着でもあるってイメージかな。\n王子は華があるか:
It's armor, sure,
but I also wanted it to feel like a formal dress.
The Prince has such a regal presence, so I think it'll suit him perfectly♪
m900405.防具職人に任せたら大喜びで仕立ててくれそうだ。\n王子、ありがたく受け取っておこ:
If we leave it to an armor smith, I'm sure they'll be thrilled to craft it.
Prince, we should accept this gift graciously.
m900405.魔王との戦争のために作られて、\nでも失敗作だからと封印されて……。\nきっと、:
It was created for the war against the Demon King,
but then sealed away as a failure……
It must have suffered so much.
m900405.麒麟か……。\nん、いや、ちょっと待って。\n幻獣麒麟ならシンフーの後ろにいるよ:
The Qilin, huh…….
Wait, hold on a second.
Isn't the Phantom Beast Qilin right behind Xing-Fu?
m900405.麒麟は泰平の世に現れる瑞獣……。\n王子のことを、神獣も、幻獣も認めてくれたんだ:
The Qilin is an auspicious beast that appears in times of peace…….
Both the Divine Beast and the Phantom Beast have accepted the Prince.
We truly must strive for a peaceful world.

m920018.……そうですね。\n今は行動するしかない。:
…Indeed.
For now, we have no choice but to act.
m920018.……今回は退きます。\nしかし、次は強力な援軍が来るはずです。: …I'll withdraw this time. However, stronger reinforcements will come next.
m920018.……王子、あの魔物たちを指揮する\n方の姿に見覚えがありませんか？: …Prince, doesn't the commander of those monsters look familiar?
m920018.……！ アンナ様！ 王子も……！\nみんな！ 王子が帰ってきたぞ！:
…! Lady Anna! The prince…!
Everyone! The prince has returned!
m920018.あなたの国は魔物たちに滅ぼされたと\n聞いています。\nなぜその国の方が王子を？: I've heard your kingdom was destroyed by monsters. Why would that nation target the Prince?
m920018.あの額当ての紋章、たしか\n砂漠の国の王族のものです。\nでは、あの方は王族の…: That crest on his forehead plate… it's the royal emblem of the desert kingdom. So that person must be royalty….
m920018.ありがとうございます。\nこんな私のために……。:
Thank you.
For someone like me...
m920018.いいえ、どうやら助けを求めに\nきたのではないようですね……。: No, it doesn't seem they came asking for assistance….
m920018.くっ……、遅かったようですね。\n建物にも火の手が……！: Damn… we were too late. The buildings are already on fire!
m920018.くっ、ここまでか……！\n……撤退する！:
Damn, this is as far as we go…!
...We retreat!
m920018.ここで迎え撃ちましょう！\n王子、戦の準備を！: Let's meet them here! Prince, prepare for battle!
m920018.ここは敵の出方を見た上で対応を決めるべきと\r\n進言させて頂きます。: I suggest we first observe the enemy's movements before deciding how to respond.
m920018.ここまでの遠征で兵たちが\n疲弊しています。: Our troops are exhausted from the expedition so far.
m920018.この剣の真の力を解放します。\n私たちの本気と意地……、\n見せてあげましょう。:
I will unleash the true power of this sword.
Our resolve and pride...
We'll show them.
m920018.この国の王子は戦上手と聞くが……。\nその首、必ずや次の戦で……！:
I've heard the prince of this land is a skilled fighter…
His head will be mine in the next battle!
m920018.この戦いでは私も出る！: I'll join the fight this time!
m920018.この戦いに勝ち、お話を聞き出しましょう！: Let's win this and get the truth out of him!
m920018.この過酷な環境で戦うには十分な\n準備が必要だと、この身をもって\n体験すること: I've learned firsthand that fighting in this harsh environment takes proper preparation.
m920018.これまでのマミーよりも、\n強力な個体だと思われます。\n気をつけてください！: It looks far stronger than any mummy we've faced before. Be careful!
m920018.しかし、敵の戦力を削ぐ事には成功しています。\nもう少し、後一押しで勝てます！:
However, we did manage to weaken the enemy's forces.
With just a little more push, we could have won!
m920018.しかし、洞窟内で砂漠の王国の兵士の姿を\n目撃したという報告もあります。: However, there are reports of sightings of soldiers from the Desert Kingdom inside the cave.
m920018.ただ、マミーはミイラが魔物になった存在……。\r\n海を越えた砂漠の国にしかいな: But mummies are mummies turned into monsters… they should only exist in the desert kingdom across the sea.
m920018.ただ、一つ、心残りといえば\n祖国に残る民たちです……。: But one thing still haunts me—the people left behind in our land...
m920018.では私は遠征の段取りを\n進めておきます。: Then I'll handle the expedition arrangements.
m920018.どうやらこの洞窟内の敵は、\n全て倒したみたいですね。: It looks like we've defeated every enemy in this cave.
m920018.どんな罰も受け入れます。\n祖国を出た時からその覚悟はできています……。:
I'll accept any punishment.
I've been prepared for this ever since I left our homeland...
m920018.なぜ砂漠からきたマミーが\nこの洞窟に……？: Why is a mummy from the desert in this cave…?
m920018.なんとか撃退する事ができましたね。: We managed to drive them off, at least.
m920018.ふふっ、王子ならばそう言うと\n思いました。: Heh, I thought you'd say that, Prince.
m920018.まずは、女神アイギス様へご報告致しましょう。: First, let's report this to Goddess Aegis.
m920018.もう戦うのはやめてください！\nこれ以上私たちが争う意味はないはずです！: Please stop fighting! There's no reason for us to keep this battle going!
m920018.もう負けは許されない。\n祖国で待つ民のためにも……！:
We can't afford another defeat.
For the people waiting back in our homeland...!
m920018.もしや異国を滅ぼした魔物たちが、海を越えて\r\nやってきたということでしょうか: Could it be that the monsters that destroyed that foreign land have crossed the sea and come here...?
m920018.ゆけ、呪われし兵士たちよ。\nこの国の王子を抹殺するのだ！:
Forward, cursed soldiers.
Assassinate the kingdom's prince!
m920018.われわれに助けを求めにきたのかも\nしれません。: Perhaps they came seeking our help.
m920018.アンナ、遠征の準備を。\n砂漠の国を救いに行く。:
Anna, prepare the expedition.
We must go save the Desert Kingdom.
m920018.ホルエス様、弱音を吐かれないでください。\n私たちには、この戦いに勝つしか\n選:
Lord Horus, please don't lose heart.
We have no choice but to win this battle.
m920018.ホルエス様！ いらしていたのですね。\n申し訳ございません。\n残念ながら、負け:
Lord Horus! You have arrived.
My apologies.
Unfortunately, we have been defeated…
m920018.人質を解放し、祖国を復興する事ができれば、\nあの魔物にも一矢報いるチャンスが訪:
If we can free the hostages and rebuild our homeland,
we'll have a chance to strike back at those monsters.
m920018.今、兵士たちが洞窟内部の\n調査をしている所です。: The soldiers are currently investigating inside the cave.
m920018.今は無き砂漠の王国。\n私はその王族の一人なのです。: It was the desert kingdom that no longer exists. I am one of its royalty.
m920018.今回の戦いは私も出陣します。: I'll join the battle this time as well.
m920018.今夜、最後の戦いを仕掛けます。\n皆さん、私についてきてください。:
Tonight, we launch the final battle.
Everyone, follow me.
m920018.今度は私たちが憎しみの対象に\nなるのでしょうね……。: This time, we will become the target of hatred…
m920018.伝令！ 敵の大部隊がこちらに向けて進軍中！\n軍勢はこれまでで最大の規模と思われ:
Messenger! A massive enemy force is marching toward us!
It looks like the largest army we've ever faced!
m920018.伝令！ 王城に多数の敵あり！\n至急、お戻りください！:
Messenger! The royal castle is swarming with enemies!
Return immediately!
m920018.位が高い王族はすべて魔物に殺され、\n私は唯一生き残った存在です。: All the high-ranking royals were slain by monsters, and I'm the sole survivor.
m920018.先ほどの戦いで現れた動くミイラ達は\r\nおそらく、『マミー』と呼ばれる\r\n: Those animated mummies we saw in the last fight are likely undead monsters known as “Mummies.”
m920018.分かっています……！\nしかし、王国の民が人質にとられている以上、\n従う事しか: I understand! But with the kingdom's people held hostage, I have no choice but to obey…
m920018.初戦は我らの負けか……。: Our first battle was a loss…
m920018.味方の増援が追いついたようですね。\nここからが本番ですよ。: Our reinforcements have finally caught up. This is where the real fight begins.
m920018.報告します！ ただいま洞窟内の魔物たちが\n進軍を開始！\n骸の兵士とマミーが確: Report! Monsters have begun advancing inside the cave! We've confirmed skeletal soldiers and a mummy!
m920018.帰りを待つ民のため……？\nやはり、訳ありのようですね。: For the people waiting back home…? So there's indeed a reason.
m920018.御意。どこまでもお供いたします。\nたとえ、魔の力を借りようとも。:
As you wish. I'll follow you anywhere.
Even if we have to borrow demonic power.
m920018.我ら砂漠の戦士も、複数配置についています。\n必ずや勝利しましょう！:
We, the Desert Warriors, are also deployed in multiple positions.
We will surely claim victory!
m920018.戦いをやめる訳にはいきません！\n祖国で私の帰りを待つ民のためにも！: I can't end the fight! Not when my people back home are waiting for my return!
m920018.戦の準備をはじめましょう。\n今夜の戦いに全てを懸けます！:
Let's begin preparations for war.
We'll stake everything on tonight's fight!
m920018.手強い！ このままでは……！: They're too strong! If this continues…!
m920018.敵の近くに配置される際は、\nお気をつけてください！: Be careful when positioning near the enemy!
m920018.敵軍の中にマミーもいる事から、\n敵は恐らく砂漠の王国からの刺客でしょう……。: Since there's a mummy among the enemy forces, the attackers are probably assassins from the Desert Kingdom…
m920018.普段はそれほどの脅威ではないのですが\r\n傷つけられるとその力が増す、という恐: They're not usually a big threat, but I've heard they grow stronger when they're wounded—a terrifying trait.
m920018.暑い……。\n話には聞いていましたが\n本当に過酷な環境ですね……。:
It's hot....
I heard about it, but the environment is truly harsh...
m920018.本当に申し訳なく思っています。\n謝って済む問題ではない事も\nわかっています…:
I'm truly sorry.
I know this isn't something an apology can fix...
m920018.次の戦いの時こそは……。\n王子の命を必ずやもらいうけます。: When the next battle comes, I will definitely claim the Prince's life.
m920018.準備が終わり次第向かいましょう。\n新たな敵が住む地、砂漠の国へ。:
As soon as preparations are complete, we'll head out.
To the desert land where new enemies dwell.
m920018.滅ぼされた国の人間同士が戦うなんて、\nあまりにも悲しいです……。: It's heartbreaking that the survivors of a destroyed nation are forced to fight each other…
m920018.王国を占領した魔物に、\n『王子を倒す事ができれば王国を返す』と\n言われ、海を: The monsters that occupied the kingdom told me, “If you can defeat the Prince, we'll return the kingdom.” So I crossed the sea.
m920018.王城さえ落せばこちらの物だ！\n一気に決めるぞ！:
Once we take the royal castle, it's ours!
We'll finish this in one blow!
m920018.王子、急ぎ王城に戻りましょう！: Prince, we must hurry back to the castle!
m920018.王子、戦いの準備を！\nこの魔物たちを外に出すわけにはいきません！:
Prince, prepare for battle!
We can't let these monsters escape!
m920018.王子、戦の準備は整いました。\n迎撃の指揮をお願いします！:
Prince, our preparations are complete.
Please lead the counterattack!
m920018.王子、敵の規模から見ておそらく\n最後の決戦になると思われます。:
Prince, judging by the enemy's size,
this will likely be the final showdown.
m920018.王子、砂漠の国の方たちをなんとか\n救う方法はないのでしょうか……？: Prince, is there any way we can save the people of that desert kingdom…?
m920018.王子、魔物を目撃したと報告があった\n洞窟はこちらです。: Prince, the cave where we received reports of monster sightings is this way.
m920018.王子たちが帰ってくるまで\n守れ！ 守りぬけ！！:
Hold the line until the princes return!
Defend! Defend to the last!
m920018.王子のお気持ちはお察し致しますが、\r\n敵の兵力や目的が分からない以上、\r\: I understand how you feel, Prince, but since we don't know the enemy's numbers or motives, we shouldn't rush into an attack.
m920018.王子の命を狙っているようでしたし、\nなにか深い理由がありそうですね。: They seemed to be targeting your life, Prince, so there must be some deeper reason.
m920018.王子！ マミーと魔物たちが王国に向かって\n進軍しているようです！: Prince! It looks like the mummies and monsters are marching toward the kingdom!
m920018.王子！ 敵の後方に\n巨大なマミーの姿が見えます！: Prince! I see a huge mummy in the enemy's rear!
m920018.申し訳ありませんが、\n本気をださせて頂きます。: I'm sorry, but I'll have to give it my all.
m920018.皆の者、よく耐えてくれました！: Everyone, thank you for holding out so well!
m920018.私たちが成そうとしている事は\n砂漠の王国を襲った魔物と同じです……。: What we're trying to achieve is the same as the monsters that attacked the Desert Kingdom…
m920018.私たちの敗北が魔物に伝わった後、\nどんな仕打ちが待っているか……。:
After our defeat reaches the monsters,
what fate awaits them...
m920018.私は後に引けない立場……。: I can't afford to fall back now.
m920018.絶対に負けるわけにはいきません。\n王子の命を頂きます！ 覚悟……！: I must not lose. I'll claim the Prince's life! Prepare yourself…!
m920018.自らが助かるために魔物の手先となった\n私たちが勝てる道理など、\n初めからなか:
We became the monsters' pawns just to survive,
so there was never any chance of us winning, was there?
m920018.見事な戦でした。\n流石、我が王国の誇る戦士ですね。:
A splendid battle.
As expected, you are truly the pride of our kingdom.
m920018.謎の船が流れ着いたというのはここです。\n異国の船でしょうか……。: They say a mysterious ship washed ashore here. I wonder if it's a foreign vessel….
m920018.配置されたユニットは、HPが減った状態から\n戦う事になります。: The units we've placed will have to fight with reduced HP.
m920018.魔物たちよ、進みなさい！\nこの国の王子を倒すのです！: Monsters, move forward! Defeat the kingdom's prince!
m920018.（この国の王子を倒せば、民たちを解放する……。\n それが本当かなんてわからない: (If I take down the kingdom's prince, I can free my people… I don't even know if that's true.)
m920018.（この城さえ攻め落とせれば、\n 後は王子を捕らえるのみ）:
(If we can take this castle,
then all that's left is to capture the prince.)
m920018.（この王国に恨みはありませんが、\n 祖国で待つ民のため……。）: (I hold no grudge against this kingdom, but for the people waiting back home….)
m920018.（もう後がない……。\n 私にはこうするしかない……！）: (There's no turning back now… I have no choice but this…!)
m920018.（敵軍の空気が一変した？\n なるほど、王子が帰ってきたか）:
(The enemy's morale has shifted?
I see, the prince has come back.)
m920018.（私が、生き残った私がやらないと……！): (If I'm the only one who survived, I have to do this…!)

m920051.……くそっ！ くそっ！ \nあともう少しだったというのに……っ！！\nおのれ王子: …Damn! Damn! It was so close…!! You wretched Prince…!! You…!!
m920051.……というわけで、私たちはここの森を守るために\n来たんです。: …So, we're here to protect this forest.
m920051.……オークが去って行きます。\nひとまずこの森は安全になりましたね。: …The Orc is leaving. For now, this forest is safe again.
m920051.……先ほどから騒がしいな……。\n一体なんなのだ……。: …It's been noisy ever since earlier... What on earth is going on...?
m920051.……好きにしろ。俺は強いやつと戦うだけだ……！: …Do as you please. I'll just fight the strong ones…!
m920051.あ、わ、わかったわかったっ！\nそうだったな！:
Ah, I—got it, got it!
Right, right!

m920051.あれは……さっきの強いやつら……っ！！ \nふはははっ……また戦えるぞ……、\n: Those… the strong ones from earlier…! Hahaha… we can fight again…! Let's fight!!
m920051.あれは、ハイオークじゃな。\nまた厄介な奴がでてきたものじゃ。: That's a high-orc over there. Another troublesome one shows up.
m920051.いいぞ……ゾクゾクしてくる……。: Nice… it's giving me a thrill…
m920051.いやはや。実に面白いものを見せてもらったよ。: Well now. That was truly entertaining to watch.
m920051.ううん、分からない。\nでも、この地には沢山の名もなき戦士たちが眠ってて、\n彼: No, I don't. But many nameless warriors lie buried here, and their relics are offered as tribute, so perhaps…
m920051.うぬ。ハイオークはオークの純血種じゃ。\nそれゆえ、力の凶暴さもオークとはケタ違: Indeed. High-orcs are pure-blood Orcs. Their ferocity is on a whole other level.
m920051.うるさい！ 俺に指図するな！！\n……ちっ、この森の奥に行けば\n強い奴がいるん: Shut up! Don't tell me what to do!! …Tch, so there's stronger ones deeper in this forest, huh!?
m920051.おい、あそこにいるやつら強そうだな。俺は戦うぞ。\n強いやつと戦うことが俺のすべ: Hey, those guys over there look strong. I'll take them on. Fighting strong opponents is everything to me… I won't let you get in my way…!
m920051.おそらくこの付近に\n魔物たちがいると思われます。\nどうかお気を付けください。:
I suspect the monsters are around here.

m920051.お任せください！ 必ずやご期待に応えて見せます！: Leave it to me! I'll surely live up to your expectations!

Your strength is feared by all.
Fight to your heart's content.

Are you injured?
If you'd like, please tell us the details.

m920051.くそ……。これじゃまともに探すこともできぬ。\nオーク共なんぞ放っておいて\n一: Damn... This makes searching properly impossible. I'd like to pull back and leave the Orcs alone for now, but...
m920051.くそっ。何とか逃げ切れたからいいものの……。: Damn it. I managed to escape, but…
m920051.ぐ……。さっきから我輩の邪魔をしよって……。\n貴様ら何者だ！: Grr… You've been getting in my way this whole time… Who the hell are you!
m920051.ぐぁああ！！ 俺は、まだ、まだ戦えるぞおおお！！: Guaaa!! I can still… still keep fighting!!
m920051.ぐぬぬ……。\nアレさえあればこのような野蛮なヤツらを利用する\n必要などないと: Damn... If only we had that, we wouldn't need to use these barbaric brutes!
m920051.こう……体の中から力が湧き上がるような……。: It's like… a force rising from within my body…
m920051.ここで争うことは、\n静かに眠る戦士たちへの冒涜であり、\n何者であろうと討伐す: To fight here would be a blasphemy against those peacefully resting warriors, and I'll slay anyone who dares.
m920051.ここには英霊たちが眠っているだけで、\n魔物が欲しがるものなんてないはずだけど…:
Only heroic spirits lie here; there shouldn't be anything
monsters would want...
m920051.ここはソルジャーの戦士が眠る石碑。\n石碑に眠る彼らの魂が、ソルジャーに力を与え: This is the monument where the Soldier warriors rest. Their souls linger here, lending power to the Soldiers.
m920051.ここはワルキューレの戦士たちの魂が眠る場所。\n戦士たちの魂が、\n力を与えてく:
This is where the Valkyrie warriors' souls rest.
Perhaps their spirits are lending us strength.
m920051.ここも外れか……。もっと奥の方を探さねば。: This place is a dead end too… We need to search deeper.
m920051.こちらから剣戟が聞こえてきたが、\nいったい何事だ！？\nむっ、立ち去った後か…:
I heard clashing swords from this direction—what on earth is happening?!
Huh, must've been after they left...
m920051.この森にアレがあるはず……。\n何としても手に入れてみせる。: That thing must be in this forest… I'll get it no matter what.
m920051.この湧き上がる力……！！ うおおお！！\n敵なんざこの拳で蹴散らしてやるぜ！！:
This surging power...!! Uoooo!!
I'll kick those enemies away with my fists!!
m920051.これからの戦いは、もっと身を引き締めなければ\nいけませんね。:
From now on, we'll have to tighten our resolve
for the battles ahead.
m920051.こんな感覚初めてだ……。\n魔法剣士の石碑のお陰だな。\nそれからお前、前のボタ: I've never felt this before… It's thanks to the mage-swordsman's monument. And you, you pressed the wrong button earlier.
m920051.こんな森の深くまで……。\n王子、急ぎ戦闘の準備を！:
All the way deep into this forest...
Prince, hurry and ready the troops!
m920051.さぁ、強きものよ。俺と戦え！: Come on, strong one. Face me!
m920051.さすがはオークだ！\nその力を存分に振るうがよかろう。\n（その隙に我輩は先へ急: That's the Orc spirit! Use that power to its fullest. (While you're at it, I'll make a dash ahead.)
m920051.さっきは危ないところを助けてくれてありがとう。\nアタシはあの聖なる森で番人をし: Thanks for saving me from that dangerous spot earlier. I'm the guardian of the Holy Forest, Ricola.
m920051.そう興奮するなオーク。\nこの先におびき寄せようではないか。: Calm down, Orc. Let's lure them further ahead.
m920051.そしてあの証が持つ力を使い、自らが団長となって\n新しい『暗黒騎士団』を作るのだ: Then I'll use the power of that insignia to become the commander myself and forge a new “Dark Knight Order”!!
m920051.それがあれば、君の元には\nすぐに新しい暗黒騎士たちが集まるだろう。: With that, new Dark Knights will gather around you in no time.
m920051.それにしても、\nこんな森の奥まで魔物が入り込むなんて、\nやっぱり何かを探して:
Still, monsters have penetrated deep into this forest.
They must be after something.
m920051.それに今回の襲撃は、魔物が森で何かを探しているようにも\n見えたっていうか……。: And this raid… it almost seemed like the monsters were looking for something in the forest.
m920051.た、確かに……。不思議な力を感じます。: Y-yes… I can feel a strange power.
m920051.だが……弱く目障りな奴がいなくなったおかげで、\nむしろ戦いに専念できるというも: But thanks to that weak, bothersome one being gone, I can focus on the battle instead.
m920051.だが王子とハイオークどもまでいるとは……。\nこうなったら奴らの戦闘の隙をついて: But the Prince and those High Orcs are still here… If that's the case, I'll strike during their battle and snatch the Commander's insignia!
m920051.ちぃっ。もう追いついてきたのか。: Tsk. They've already caught up, have they?
m920051.ちょっとそれあたしのセリフ！！\nでもたしかにこの力、体がうずうずしてくる……！:
Hey, that's my line!!
But yeah, this power makes my body tingle...!!
Must be thanks to that monument!
m920051.ちょっとちょっと。\n残念だけど、団長の剣をそう易々と\n渡す訳にはいかないわ。: Hold on a sec. Sorry, but we can't just hand over the Commander's sword so easily.
m920051.では、王子。城に帰りましょうか。: Then, Prince, shall we return to the castle?
m920051.でもまぁどんなに強い相手でも、\nお前にかかればあっという間だろう！: But honestly, no matter how strong the opponent, if it's you, it'll be over in a flash!
m920051.でもアタシの野生の勘では、\n何者かが意図的に裏で糸を引いている……、\nそんな: But my gut tells me someone's pulling the strings behind the scenes… I can't shake that feeling.
m920051.とはいえこのまま見過ごすわけにもいきません。\n王子、先へ進みましょう。: Still, we can't just ignore this. Prince, let's move forward.
m920051.どうにか倒すことができましたが、\nまさかオークよりも強いハイオークまで\n現れ: We managed to defeat it, but I never expected even a high-orc, stronger than the regular Orcs, to appear...
m920051.どうやらあの石碑は、\nアーチャーに力を与えてくれるみたいです！: Looks like that stone monument gives power to archers!
m920051.どちらにしても、\n今回の襲撃はアタシ一人じゃどうにもならない。\nだから王子、: Either way, I can't handle this raid on my own. So, Prince, lend me your strength!
m920051.どれ。我輩は近くの道を行く。\nオークたちは他の道を抑えておいてくれないか？:
Now then, I'll take the nearby path.
Orcs, could you hold the other routes?
m920051.なに、慌てずとも強い奴らとはまた戦える。: No need to panic—we'll still get to face some strong foes.
m920051.なに！ あの噂の英雄の末裔の……。\nわ、わかった！ 降参しよう！\nこの森では: What! The rumored descendant of the heroes… Alright, alright! I'll surrender! I was just looking for something in this forest!
m920051.なるほど、そういうことだったのか。\n早とちりしてしまって、すまなかったな。: I see. My mistake, I jumped to conclusions. Sorry about that.
m920051.なんだお前たちは？ 強そうだな……。\n強そうな奴らと出会ったならば、俺の獲物。: Who are you? You look strong... If I meet strong guys like you, they're my prey. I won't let you get away...!
m920051.なんだかここにいると、力が湧いてくる気が……。: Being here somehow makes me feel power surging through me...
m920051.なんだか不思議な感じです。これは一体……。:
It feels so strange.
What on earth is this...
m920051.なんなの？\nここにいると、なんだか力が湧いてくる……。:
What is this?
Being here... I feel a surge of power.
m920051.はぁ……。\n先が思いやられるな……。: Haa… The road ahead looks daunting…
m920051.ふはは！！ \nこれでいよいよ我輩も大いなる力を……！！: Fuhaha!! With this, at long last I'll obtain great power…!!
m920051.ふん。\n休憩後の運動がてら、俺たちも混ざるとするか。: Hmph. As a post-break workout, shall we join in?
m920051.ほう……。これはなんとも不思議だ。\nどうやらここは私たちメイジに\n力を与えて: Huh… How curious. It seems this place is granting power to us mages.
m920051.ほう……。道に迷って休んでいただけだったが……、\nなにやら面白いことになってい: Hmm... I was just resting after getting lost, but... seems something interesting is happening.
m920051.ま、まてまてオーク！\nここで無駄な体力を使うよりも、一旦引いて\n態勢を立て直: Hold on, hold on, Orc! Instead of wasting HP here, why not pull back and regroup? Right?
m920051.まさかこんなところでハイオークに出会うとはな。: I never imagined I'd meet a High Orc here.
m920051.まるで泉のように魔力が湧き出てくる……！: The magical energy is bubbling up like a spring!
m920051.もう逃げられません！\n魔物たちを先導していたのはあなたですね？: There's no escaping now! You were the one leading those monsters, weren't you?

m920051.わかったわ。\n団長の前で無様に負ける訳にはいかないしね。: Understood. I won't lose disgracefully in front of the Commander.
m920051.わかったわかった！ そう怒らないでくれ！\n見えなかっただけなんだ！\nお前の好: Got it, got it! Don't get so angry! I just didn't see them! Do whatever you want!
m920051.んもー！ なんなのよあんたたちー！\nこれ以上この森を荒らさせないんだから！: Ugh! What are you guys doing! I'm not gonna let you trash this forest any further!
m920051.ん？\nあそこに刺さっているあの剣、なにやら強そうだな。\n俺が勝ったあかつきに: Huh? That sword stuck over there looks pretty powerful. When I win, I'll take it for myself.
m920051.ん？ あそこに見えるのは……まさか団長の証！\nついに見つけたぞ！！: Huh? What I see over there… could it be the Commander's insignia! At last, I've found it!!
m920051.アレさえ手に入れば強力な力が我輩の手に……。\nだが、ゴブリンどもでは役に立たぬ:
If I get that thing, a great power will be mine… But goblins aren't any help.
Go! Orcs!!

m920051.オークなどに頼らずとも、証さえあれば……\n我輩は新たな暗黒騎士団を結成する事が: Even without the Orcs, if I have the seal… I can form a new Dark Knight Order!
m920051.オークよ。ご所望の強い奴が来たぞ。: Orcs, the strong one you requested has arrived.
m920051.ケタ違いだなんて……！ \n王子、ここは慎重に進みましょう！: A whole other level...! Prince, we should proceed cautiously!

Gegyagyah……!!
You meddling pests, one by one, I'll crush you……!!
m920051.一体何を探していたんですか？: What exactly were you searching for?
m920051.下手にこそこそ行くよりも、\nオーク共の進軍に紛れた方が早いかもしれんな。\n連: It might be faster to blend in with the Orcs' advance than to sneak around. They're so eager they've found their prey...
m920051.何かを探しているのかどうか、その真相はわからない……。: I have no idea whether they're after something or what the truth is…
m920051.何か重要なものがこの地にあるのかもしれません。\nとにかく先を急ぎましょう。:
Perhaps something important lies in this land.
Let's hurry forward.
m920051.何とか撃退できました。\nひとまずこの場は収まったようです。\n参りましょう、王: We managed to drive them off. For now, the area seems settled. Let's go, Prince.
m920051.俺に指図するな……っ！: Don't tell me what to do…!
m920051.元暗黒騎士を舐めないことね。: Don't underestimate a former Dark Knight.
m920051.先ほどの魔物たちでしょうか。\n急ぎ戦闘の準備を！:
Those must be the same monsters from before.
Quickly, prepare for battle!
m920051.全く……。オーク共にも困ったものだ。\nここは先に進み、目的の物を見つけるのが先: Honestly… even the Orcs are a hassle. We should push forward and find what we came for.
m920051.全く、何とも情けなく愚かなものよ。\n強き者を前にして、戦わず逃げるなど……。\: Honestly, how pitifully foolish. To flee without a fight before a stronger opponent… I'm utterly exasperated.
m920051.前の団長もなかなか愉快なものだったけど、\n君はまた違った面白さがありそうだね。: The previous commander was quite a character, but you seem to have a different kind of intrigue. I'm looking forward to it.
m920051.力が溢れてきているぞ……。\nただでさえ隙のない俺が、さらに強く！: My power is surging… Even I, already flawless, am getting stronger!
m920051.勝利を団長への手向けとしよう。: Let our victory be an offering to the Commander.

m920051.喜べ。再び強い奴らがやって来たようだぞ。\nオークの力をもってすれば、\n倒すこ: Rejoice. Strong foes have arrived again. With the Orcs' strength, defeating them should be a breeze, don't you think?
m920051.団長のお墓参りに来たってだけなのに。\n団長の心がアタシたちに呼びかけたのかしら: I only came to pay respects at the Commander's grave. I wonder if the Commander's spirit called out to us?
m920051.団長の証だ。暗黒騎士団のな。: The commander's seal—of the Dark Knight Order.
m920051.団長の証？ リコラさん何かご存じですか？: The commander's seal? Ricola, do you know anything about that?

m920051.実に楽しい戦いだった。\n機会があればまたいずれ会おう。: That was a truly enjoyable fight. If the chance arises, let's meet again someday.
m920051.強いやつがいるというから来てやっただけだ。\n暗黒騎士デシウスとやら。\nお前の:
I only came because I heard someone strong was here. That Dark Knight Decius, right?
I never agreed to be your subordinate…
m920051.強いやつは俺の獲物だ。\nすべて倒す……！: The strong are my prey. I'll crush them all!

In this sacred ground where warriors' souls rest,
we can't allow conflict! As a Valkyrie, I must stop it at all costs!
m920051.撃退はできたけど、\nやっぱり敵の目的は見えないままだね。: We managed to drive them off, but we still have no clue what the enemy's goal is.
m920051.本当にありがとうっ！\nこの森に眠る戦士の魂も\nきっと安心して眠れるに違いない: Thank you so much! The souls of the warriors sleeping in this forest can finally rest in peace.
m920051.来たか……。待ちくたびれるところだった。: They've come... I was getting bored waiting.
m920051.王子、ここが「聖なる森」……。\n戦いで命を落とした戦士たちの魂が\n眠る場所に: Prince, this is the Holy Forest… the place where the souls of fallen warriors rest.
m920051.王子、こちらです！\nあそこにハイオークが！: Prince, over here! There's a High Orc over there!
m920051.王子、オークがあそこに！: Prince, the Orc is over there!
m920051.王子、敵が逃げます！\n急ぎ私たちも追いかけましょう！: Prince, the enemy's retreating! Let's give chase!
m920051.王子！ どうやらまだ襲撃は続いているようです。\n私たちも加勢いたしましょう！: Prince! It looks like the raid is still going. We'll join the fight!
m920051.王子！ オークたちを発見しました！\n急ぎ戦闘の準備を！: Prince! We've spotted the Orcs! Hurry and prepare for battle!
m920051.王子！ 敵が森の奥へ向かいます！\n私たちも追いかけましょう！: Prince! The enemy's heading deeper into the forest! Let's give chase!
m920051.番人として、聖なる森を魔物の手から守りたいの！: As the guardian, I want to protect the Holy Forest from the monsters!
m920051.知っての通り、あの聖なる森は戦いで命を落とした\n戦士たちの魂が集う場所……。: As you know, this Holy Forest is where the souls of warriors who fell in battle gather.
m920051.確か、オークは体力が半分になると狂戦士化すると\n以前、兵士長が話していました。: If I recall correctly, the Sergeant said that Orcs go berserk when their HP drops to half. If that happens, they'll land a serious blow—watch out.
m920051.確かに以前からちょくちょく魔物が迷い込むことは\nあったんだけど……。\nでもさ: Sure, monsters have wandered in from time to time before, but… this is the first time they've come in hordes like that.
m920051.私たちは英雄の末裔の王子が率いる軍です。\n降参、していただけますね？: We're the army led by the Prince, descendant of the heroes. You'll surrender, won't you?
m920051.私の名はエミリア。\nこの地に眠る戦士たちを天界へ導くものだ。: I am Emilia, the one who guides the warriors sleeping in this land to the heavens.
m920051.私は他の場所を巡回する。\n悪いがここでお別れだ。: I'll be patrolling elsewhere. Sorry, but this is where we part ways.
m920051.証を……、\n『団長』の証さえあれば力を手に入れることが\n出来たというのに……: If only I had the… the Commander's seal, I could have gained that power…!!
m920051.逃がさぬぞ……！ お前らぁああ！！: We won't let you escape...! You all!!
m920051.魔物の襲撃だけど……突然だったから\nアタシもよくわからないの。: It's a monster raid, but it came out of nowhere, so even I don't really know what's going on.
m920051.魔術師も合流したことだし、\nここからはもっと楽しい戦いになるだろう……。:
With the mage joining us,
the fight from here on out will be even more fun...
m920051.（さすがはこの我輩。\nもはやオークなど我輩の手の内よ）:
(As expected of me.
Orcs are already at my fingertips.)
m920051.（やはり我輩には統率する力が備わっている。\nあとはアレさえあれば……）:
(Indeed, I possess the power to command.
All that's left is that one thing...)
m920051.（今のうちだ……！）\nハッ、馬鹿め！ 誰が貴様らなどに降参するものか！: (Now's my chance…!) Hah, you fool! Who would ever surrender to the likes of you!
m920051.（我輩は森に身を隠してやつらを\n後ろから攻撃させてもらうがな）: (I'll hide in the forest and let them attack from behind.)

m920066.――……グ、グフフフ……フハハハハッ！！\n遂に、我輩は必殺剣を会得したのだ！\:
――…Guh, gufhuh…
Hahaha!!
At last, I've mastered the ultimate sword!
From now on, defeat is not even a word I know!!
m920066.――『コキュートス』！？\n私の最高位魔法をあんなやつが……？: —‘Cocytus'!? That top-tier spell in the hands of someone like that…?
m920066.――お……おおおッ！？\nこれが『ダブルショット』というものか……。\n団長、必:
—Whoa…?!
So that's what they call “Double Shot”…
Commander, I'll make sure victory is yours!!
m920066.――ぐッ、ガ……はぁッ……ハァ……。\n我輩の必殺剣が……敗れる、だと……？: ――Guh, gah… ha… ha… My ultimate sword… is about to be defeated, huh?
m920066.――だ、団長ッ！ \n別部隊より、『例のモノ』を発見したとの報せ！\nここは我ら: —Lord! Reports from another unit say they've found "the thing"! Leave this to us and hurry!
m920066.――っと、忘れるところだった。\nこれを貴様に授けよう。数ある英霊の中でも\n最: —Ah, I almost forgot. I'll give this to you. Among all the heroes, this is the one I've saved for the very end.
m920066.――トリプルショット……！？\n容易く口にしてくれますね……。\nこの戦い……絶: —Triple Shot...? You say that so easily... This battle... we cannot afford to lose!
m920066.…………あの二人、また戦い始めてますけど。\n王子との戦いで疲弊していたのに……: …Those two have started fighting again. Even though they're exhausted from battling you, Prince… are they really okay?
m920066.……あれは……尖鋭弾ッ！？？\n何であんな奴らがそんな技を使えるのよ？: …What… that's a… Piercing Shot!?? How can they even use a technique like that?
m920066.……いいでしょう。\n最強の魔女を目指す私への挑戦状ですね。\n誰であろうと容赦: …Very well. A challenge to the witch who aims to be the strongest. I won't show mercy to anyone.
m920066.……う、うるさい！ もう騙されぬぞ！\n我輩は我輩のやり方で最強となるのだ！\n:
…Shut up! I won't be fooled again!
I'll become the strongest my way!
I will never lose anything precious again!
m920066.……ここが、英霊の眠る聖なる森。\n清浄な気に満ちた、美しい場所ですね。\n本当:
…This is the sacred forest where the heroic souls rest.
It's a beautiful place, filled with pure air.
Could monsters really appear here?
m920066.……そんなこと、信じられるか！\n貴方は、我輩の力を恐れていただけだ！:
…I can't believe that!
You were only afraid of my power!
m920066.……デシウス……か？\nお前の事は案じておったが、その漆黒の鎧……。\n暗黒騎士:
…Decius…?
I've been worried about you, but that jet-black armor…
You've become a Dark Knight…
m920066.……仕方ありませんね。\nこの場所に呼ばれた時点で、\n正直なところ、こうなる気: …It can't be helped. When we were summoned here, to be honest, I had a feeling this would happen…
m920066.……案じていた……？\n何をおっしゃるのですか……。\n貴方に奪われた未来の影が:
…You were worried…?
What are you talking about…
The shadow of the future you stole from me is this form.
m920066.……森が、泣いている……。\n魔物達が悪さをしているのは間違いないよ。\nきっと:
…The forest is weeping.
The monsters are certainly causing trouble.
Surely something is abnormal—
m920066.……王子、急ぐわよ！\nデシウスは、そう遠くに行っていないはずだわ。\nこれ以上:
…Prince, we must hurry!
Decius shouldn't be far away.
I won't let him run wild any longer.
m920066.……理解に苦しみます。\nそれは力ではなく、英霊たちの記憶……。\n私は、自分の: ...I find this hard to comprehend. It's not just power—it's the heroes' memories... I'll claim the title of strongest with my own strength.
m920066.『吸魂の力』とは、既に死んだ者の魂をその身に\n吸収することで、その魂の主が備え: The “Soul-Sucking Power” is a terrifying ability that absorbs the souls of the already dead, turning the skills the soul's former owner possessed into the user's own martial techniques.
m920066.『吸魂の力』は魔界に棲む一部の高位デーモンしか\n持ち得ないはずの異能なのだが、: That power should belong only to a few high-ranking demons dwelling in the demon realm, yet I have no idea how they can use it…
m920066.『影月七連矢』……真の輝きをその胸に刻みなさい！: “Shadow Moon Seven Arrows”… engrave its true brilliance upon your heart!
m920066.あ、ぐッ……おぉぉぉおッ！？\nち、力が……魔力が溢れてきます。\nこ、これはま: Ah, ggh… Ooooh!? The power… magic is overflowing. This… could it be the ‘Cocytus'!!
m920066.ああ、リオンの言うとおりだ。\n今ならすぐに追いつくことができるだろう。\nおお:
Yes, just as Leon says.
We should be able to catch up right now.
We have a rough idea of his position. Let's go!
m920066.あたし、あいつら絶対に許さない！\n悔しいとかずるいとかそういうのもあるけど、\: I won't let those bastards get away with this! I'm angry, it's unfair… but most of all, it's a slap in the face to our skill!
m920066.いいわ……特別に私が眼を覚まさせてあげる。\n真贋の違い、その身に刻みなさい！: Fine... I'll personally awaken your eyes this time. Let the true and false be etched upon you!
m920066.いいんです。これはボクの責任ですから。\nいつか必ず、この手で取り返してみせます: It's fine. That's my responsibility. One day I'll take it back with my own hands.
m920066.う、うるさい……！ 戦いは結果が全てだ！\n過程などに拘っていられるか！ \nさ: Shut up...! In battle, results are everything! I have no time for process! Come out now, you all!
m920066.おおっと、いくらガラニアさんと言えど、\nあの数の魔物相手では手に余ろう？\nこ: Whoa, even for you, Garania-san, handling that many monsters would be overwhelming. Let me lend my flawless power to this battle.
m920066.お前は大切な者を失い、復讐心に駆られていた。\nその念が消えぬ者にとってあの奥義:
You lost someone dear and were driven by vengeance.
For one whose hatred never fades, that technique is a double-edged blade…
It was a choice made out of love for you—how could you not understand?
m920066.くそっ……。\n英霊たちの力を得て、どうして勝てない……？: Damn it... Even after gaining the heroes' power, I still can't win...?
m920066.くそっ……また護れなかった……なぜだ？\nなぜそこまでして力を得ようとする？\n: Damn... we couldn't protect them again... Why? Why go to such lengths for power? Why not carve your own path with your own blade?
m920066.くッ……。\n更に強力なスキルを持つ英霊を見つければ\n良いだけの話だ……さらば: Hmph… If I can find a Heroic Spirit with an even stronger skill, that'll be all I need… Farewell!
m920066.こ、これはアーチャーの英霊の……！: Th-this is the soul of an Archer hero…!
m920066.ここの石碑も壊されていますね……。\nどうやら一足遅かったようです。: Even the stone monument here has been shattered... Looks like we were a step too late.
m920066.この森と、そして英霊達の安寧を取り戻す為、\nどうか私に力を貸してほしい。\n女:
To restore peace to this forest and the heroes, please lend me your strength.
The power of you, blessed by the goddess Aegis.
m920066.これが本当のトリプルショットです……。\n武を軽んじ仮初めの技に頼る貴方などに、: This is the true Triple Shot… To someone who scorns weapons and relies on fleeting tricks, there's no way you could win!
m920066.これも英霊の魂のおかげってこと？\nふざけないでよ！ 砲術学校で使用法を習って、: Is this thanks to the heroes' souls? Don't mess with me! I finally mastered this cannon fire at the artillery school…
m920066.さすが団長。\n常に新たな力で我ら暗黒騎士団の軍備を\n増強するその手腕、感服し:
As expected of the commander.
Your knack for constantly bolstering the Dark Knight Order's forces with new power is truly impressive.
m920066.しつこいやつらだ。\nなぜ我輩の邪魔をする？\nなぜ我輩が強くなりたいと思う意志: Persistent fools. Why interfere with me? Why block my will to become stronger?
m920066.して、あの石碑にはどの様な\n英霊の魂が宿っていたのですか？: So, what kind of heroic soul was sealed in that monument?
m920066.すみませんアリサさん。もしもの時の為に、\n治療の準備をしておいてください………: Sorry, Alissa. Please have the healing preparations ready, just in case… *sigh*
m920066.そういうことだ。\nさあ、我らと手合わせ願おう！\nもちろん、全力でな。: That's right. Now, let's spar! And of course, give it everything you've got.
m920066.そうだ。\nこれで貴様にも百戦錬磨の英霊と同じ強力な妙技、\nつまり『スキル』が:
Indeed.
Now you'll be able to wield the same powerful techniques as seasoned heroes—namely, a “Skill”!
m920066.そうとなれば、早速特訓だエミリア！\nよもやこの程度の傷で、\n槍術を鈍らせたり: In that case, let's start training right away, Emilia! You can't possibly let a scratch like this dull your spear skills, can you?
m920066.そう俺の剣は完璧だッ！\nって、そういう問題じゃなくてだね。\n――っあ、ああ！: Yeah, my sword is perfect! But that's not the point… —Whoa, what!? They're fleeing!?
m920066.そう簡単に逃がしてなるものか！\n王子、このまま追撃するぞ！: We won't let you slip away that easily! Prince, let's press the attack!
m920066.そう言ってもらえるのは嬉しいが、\nそれでは英霊の守り手の名折れだ。: I'm glad to hear you say that, but that would be a disgrace to the Guardians of Heroes.
m920066.その構えは『影月七連矢』！？\nそういうこと……あんたも魂を取り込んだのね。: That stance—it's the "Shadow Moon Seven Arrows"? So that's it... You've taken a soul too.
m920066.その調子だ！ 貴様は破壊者だ！ \n敵を全て、滅多打ちにするのだ！\n(さて、我: That's the spirit! You're a destroyer—obliterate every enemy! (Now, I'll hide in safety… that's the plan.)
m920066.それだけ貴方たちが自分の武技に\n誇りをもっているという証だ。: That just shows how proud you all are of your own martial arts.
m920066.それでは、戻りましょうか？\nレシアさんもエミリアさんも、無傷ではありません。\: Shall we head back then? Neither Resia nor Emilia are unscathed. They'll need immediate healing from a healer—
m920066.それは……そうですけど。\n何もこんな危険な場所で訓練をしなくても……。: Well… that's true. But we don't need to train in such a dangerous place…
m920066.それはこちらの台詞だ、レシア！\n怪我を負けの言い訳になどしてくれるなよ？\nさ: That's my line, Resia! Don't use injuries as an excuse for losing, okay? Now, let me show you the power of a Heroic Guardian!
m920066.そろそろ皆さんの準備も整ったようですね。\n王子、さらに森の奥へと向かいましょう: It seems everyone's preparations are complete. Prince, let's venture deeper into the forest.
m920066.だが、すまないことをした、ミーティア。\n貴方の師の魂を救うことはできなかった…: But I'm sorry, Meteor. I couldn't save your master's soul…
m920066.だが、現実にその力は先の敵に行使され、\n森に点在する英霊の魂は奪い取られている: In reality, that power has been employed by the enemy, and the heroic souls scattered throughout the forest are being taken.
m920066.だが敵は森に散在し、単身では物理的に\nこの事態に対処することができないのだ。: But the enemies are scattered throughout the forest, and I can't physically handle this alone.
m920066.ちッ、暴れたりないな……。\nなあ王子、早く進軍を再開しよう。\n立ち止まって考: Tch, not enough rampage... Hey Prince, let's resume the march quickly. I'm not good at standing still and pondering.
m920066.ですが、確かにあのカボチャ達の繰り出す\n炎の魔力には目を見張るべき部分がありま: But indeed, the flame magic those pumpkins unleashed was impressive. Fascinating… Shall we dissect it sometime?
m920066.な、なあガラニアさん……？\nいくら魔力の精髄を極めるのが使命とはいえ、\nあん: Hey, Garania… Even if mastering the essence of magic is your mission, shouldn't we steer clear of anything too reckless?
m920066.なに、ただ手合わせを願いたいと思ってな。\n私は王子の武勇に惹かれ、仲間になった: Nothing, I just wanted a duel. I'm drawn to your bravery, Prince, and became a comrade. But we've never actually fought together, have we?
m920066.なんだとッ！！\nわ、分かった。すまないが、ここは任せる。: What the—!! Alright, fine. Sorry, but I'll leave this to you.
m920066.なんてことだ……。\nせっかく我輩が見つけたトリプルショットの英霊を\n無駄にし: What a disaster… I finally uncovered a Triple-Shot Heroic Spirit, only to waste it…!
m920066.はぁ、ハァ……くそ、あやつら、\nなんてしつこいんだ……。\nこのままでは追いつ: Haa... ha... Damn it, they're so persistent... If this keeps up, they'll catch up to us...
m920066.はい。\n突然の事で、びっくりして……。\n私一人じゃとても抑えられなくって……:
Yes.
It happened so suddenly, I'm shocked…
I couldn't hold it back on my own…
m920066.ひぐぁ……う……うぉぉおぉおおっ！！\nこれで奴らを滅多打ちにします、団長！: Higa… u… uooo-ooo!! Now we'll crush them, Leader!
m920066.ふふ、そうですね。\n王子、それでは、戻りましょうか。\nこの度のお力添え、改め: Hehe, indeed. Prince, shall we return then? Thank you again for your assistance.
m920066.ふふ、頼もしい限りだ。\nそれでは、英霊達の魂を救う為に、\n進軍再開といこう。: Heh, how reassuring. Then, let's resume the march to save the heroes' souls.
m920066.ふむ。お前はボウガンを使っているな。\nよし、丁度良い。\nこの魂は、貴様に授け:
Hmm. You're using a crossbow, right? Good, just right.
I'll grant this soul to you.
m920066.ふん……小難しいことを考えるのは任せる。\n俺のやることは変わらない。\n目の前: Hmph... Leave the complicated stuff to you. My job stays the same: smash the monsters before us. That's all, right?
m920066.ぶ、ぶぶ、分解ッ！？？\nクヒュぅ……食べられるわけにはいかんガボ。\n……逃げ: D-dissect!?? Ku… I can't eat it… I have to run…
m920066.まあまあ、悪さをしようとしていた魔物を\n掃討することができたんだ。この完璧な勝: Well, well, we managed to sweep away the monsters that were causing trouble. Let's celebrate this perfect victory.
m920066.またも英霊の魂を利用するなんて……。\n王子、敵は新たな力を身につけています。\: Using a hero's soul again… Prince, the enemy has gained new power. Proceed with utmost caution!
m920066.また新たな英霊の魂が我が手に……。\nフハハハ……よし、次は貴様だ。\n前に出ろ: Another hero's soul falls into my grasp… Fuhahaha… Fine, you're next. Step forward!
m920066.まっかせなさい！\nこの羽に誓って、\n勝利をあなたに届けてあげようじゃない！: Leave it to me! I swear on these wings—I'll deliver victory to you!
m920066.みんな気をつけて！\nあのスキルは爆風の効果を抑えてる代わりに、\nすごく射程が: Everyone, watch out! That skill suppresses the blast, but its range is huge!
m920066.ようやく……この手に収めることができた……。\n探し求めていた魂が……。:
At last… I've finally secured it in my grasp…
The soul I've been seeking…
m920066.ようやく来たな、王子。\n貴方を……ずっと待っていた！: At last you're here, Prince. I've been waiting for you… all this time!
m920066.ようやく私の出番ですね……。\nこのトリプルショットで、\n王子軍を射貫いて見せ: Finally, my turn... With this Triple Shot, I'll pierce through the Prince's forces.
m920066.ようやく見つけたぞ、デシウス！\nこれ以上の蛮行を許しはしない……。\n悪いが、: Finally found you, Decius! I won't tolerate any more of your rampage… Sorry, but it ends here.
m920066.よし、お前にはこの魂を授けよう。\nこの力を使って、王子たちを倒すのだ！: Fine, I'll give you this soul. Use this power to defeat the princes!
m920066.よし、これでまた少し、\n英霊の魂を取り返すことができたな。: Good—now we've reclaimed a bit more of the heroes' souls.
m920066.よろしいのですか？\nそのような大事な――はゥッ！！\nふぉぉおおッ……この強大: Is that alright? Such a precious—Ha!! Gooo... This overwhelming power... could it really be!?
m920066.キング様！\n生キノ良イ魂ミツケタヨ！: King! I've found a fresh, good soul!
m920066.ギャレットさんに、ベルナールさんも\nもの凄い気迫ですね……私達も続きましょう！: Lord Garrett, Bernard, you both have incredible resolve... Let's keep going! Prince, please prepare for battle!
m920066.ギャレット殿、あまり熱くならぬように……\nって聞いておるのか？ ああ、もう……: Lord Garrett, are you hearing me tell you not to get too heated...? Ah, geez... Never mind, I'll just protect him!
m920066.クソッ！！\n滅多打ちのボッコボコにされよってからに。\n味方も残ってないし……: Damn it!! Being beaten to a pulp by that relentless onslaught... No allies left... I'll retreat!
m920066.クヒュヒュー！ \n炎のパワーが高まるのを感じるカボ！ \nいつもより３段階も広: Ku-hyu-! I can feel the flame power rising, pumpkins! It looks like we can scorch an area three times wider than usual!
m920066.クヒューッ！ いいところに来たカボ！？\nボクの新しい力を見せてアゲルカボ！\n: Ku-hyu-! Right on time, pumpkins! I'll show you my new power! I'll scorch everything!
m920066.グフフ……何をバカなことを言っている？\n我輩の必殺剣は完璧だ！\n貴様の父と同:
Guh… What nonsense are you spouting?
My ultimate sword is perfect!
I've obtained the same power as your father!
m920066.グフフ……！\n随分と遅かったな、王子！\n既にここの英霊の魂は頂いたぞ！: Guffaw...! You were terribly late, Prince! I've already taken the hero's soul here!
m920066.グフフフ……これが吸魂の力か。\n素晴らしい！:
Guff… so this is the Soul-Sucking Power.
Wonderful!
m920066.グフフフ……大事に使うのだぞ。\nでは我輩は行く。次に会うときは、\n最強の騎士: Guff... Use it wisely. Now, I'm off. When we meet again, I swear I'll be the strongest knight. Farewell.
m920066.コノ魂は炎ノパワーガ湧イテクルヨ！\nキング様ニピッタリダヨ！: This soul's power is bubbling with flame! It's perfect for you, King!
m920066.デシウス様……すみません……。\n私はどうやら、ここまでの……ようです……。\n: Decius... I'm sorry... It seems this is as far as I can go... Please, take the power I sought into your hands...
m920066.デシウス様は最強の騎士となる途次ゆえ、\n邪魔立ては無粋に存じます。\n押し通る: Since Decius is on the path to becoming the strongest knight, any interference would be downright uncouth. If you insist on pushing through, I'll stop you myself.
m920066.デシウス！ 既に包囲は盤石だ！\n大人しく降れ！:
Decius! The encirclement is already ironclad!
Stand down!
m920066.ハァ、ハァ……負けた。\n完膚なきまでの、敗北だ……。\n恐れ入ったよ、王子。: Hah, hah… I lost. A crushing, total defeat… I'm humbled, Prince.
m920066.ミーティアさん……。\n王子、ここでデシウスとの決着をつけましょう。:
Meteor…
Prince, let's settle this with Decius here.
m920066.レシアさん、このような所に呼び出して、\nいったい、どうしたのですか？: Resia, why did you summon us to a place like this? What's going on?
m920066.レシアさんが共に来ていただけるのは、\nこちらとしても大変喜ばしいことです。\n: It's wonderful that Resia will join us. We're very pleased. From now on, please take care of us!
m920066.レシアも同じ心持ちか？\nああ、やはり強さを求める者として、\nどんな相手であれ: Resia feels the same, huh? Yeah, anyone who craves strength knows that losing is always a bitter pill, no matter the opponent!
m920066.レシア！？ 来てくれたんだね……！\n実は、魔物が突然現れて\n石碑を壊されてし:
Resia!? You came…!
Actually, a monster appeared out of nowhere and shattered the monument…
m920066.一つ疑問に思ったのですが、\n英霊の魂を身に宿すと\n具体的にどうなるのでしょう: I have a question: when a heroic soul is lodged in someone, what exactly happens?
m920066.一つ魂を奪われる度、英霊の力が\n奴らのものになっていく……。\n状況は悪化して:
Each time a soul is taken, the heroes' power falls into their hands…
The situation only worsens.
m920066.一体なんでそんな事をするのか、\n全然分からないの……。: I have no idea why they'd do something like that…
m920066.人の心を完全に捨ててしまったようだね……。\nいいよ……同門のボクが終わらせてあ:
You've completely cast aside your humanity…
Fine. Let a fellow disciple end this.
I'll cut through all your pain and sorrow.
m920066.今の君には、敗北の理由も、\n強さの意味も、何も理解はできないだろうね。: At this point, you can't understand the reason for defeat, nor the meaning of strength.
m920066.今回のことで私は自分の不甲斐なさを痛感した。\n奪われた魂を取り返すのは勿論だが: This incident made me keenly feel my own inadequacy. Of course I want to retrieve the stolen soul, but I also want to learn your martial ways to become stronger.
m920066.伝令！！\n斥候部隊が前方に敵影を捉えた模様！\n注意してください！:
Messenger!!
Scouts have spotted enemy forces ahead!
Stay alert!
m920066.何も問題はありません。\nですから、貴方のその刃こぼれ一つ無い\n完璧な剣を私め: No problem at all. Then, please lend me your flawless, unblemished blade. Come now.
m920066.何も知らないくせに、勝手なことを言うな！\n団長の正しさは、自分が証明してみせる: Don't speak of things you know nothing about! I'll prove the leader's righteousness myself… Leader, grant me the hero's power.
m920066.何故……なぜ、このデシウスに\n奥義を伝授しなかったのですか？: Why… why didn't you teach me the ultimate technique?
m920066.先の暗黒騎士団は、\nこの森に眠る、英霊の魂を狙っている。: The Dark Knights ahead are after the heroic souls that sleep in this forest.
m920066.全てを灰に、とは随分と物騒ですね……。\n本当にその様な炎を操れるのですか？\n: Turning everything to ash… that's rather dangerous, isn't it? Can you really wield such fire? That magic is truly fascinating. I'll take you on.
m920066.全てを灰に帰してやるカボ！！: I'll turn everything to ash, pumpkins!!
m920066.共に槍術の使い手であり武人だからな、\n意気投合してしまったのだよ。\n彼女も王: Since we're both masters of the spear and warriors, we just clicked right away. It seems she also wanted to fight you, Prince.
m920066.分かりました！\n王子、レシアさんと共に、\nデシウスの後を追いましょう！: Understood! Prince, let's chase Decius together with Resia!
m920066.協力感謝する。\n奴らは、奪った英霊の魂を、\n自らの身に宿しているはず。:
Thank you for your cooperation.
They should have the stolen heroic souls lodged in their bodies.
m920066.取り戻せた森の安寧と、\nレシアさんとの出会いを喜びましょう！\n王子、この度は: Let's celebrate the forest's restored peace and our meeting with Resia! Prince, thank you for your hard work this time.
m920066.吸魂の力か……？\n仮初の必殺剣を得てどうする？\nデシウス、本当にこれがお前の:
The power of soul-draining, huh…?
What will you do with this temporary ultimate sword?
Decius, is this truly the answer you sought?
m920066.団長……どうか、良きご武運を……。: Lord... May you find glorious victory...
m920066.奴ら、どこで手に入れたかは知らないが、\n『吸魂の力』を使っているようだった。: I don't know where they got it, but they seem to be using the “Soul-Sucking Power.”
m920066.奴らの狙いは英霊の魂だ。\n奪った魂を自らに宿し、\n新たな力を手に入れている。:
Their aim is the heroic souls.
They steal the souls, embed them within themselves, and gain new power.
m920066.実戦での闘争でなくて、何が立ち合いか！\nこれは訓練ではなく、\n互いを知る為の: It's not a mock battle! This isn't training—it's a true fight to get to know each other!
m920066.強くありたいというその心意気は認めよう。\nだが、そのやり方が間違っているのだ。: I respect your desire to be strong. But your methods are wrong.
m920066.待て、デシウス！\nいったい何処に行こうっていうんだ！？: Wait, Decius! Where do you think you're going!?
m920066.待て、デシウス！\n王子、後を追うぞ！: Wait, Decius! Prince, I'm coming after you!
m920066.待てと言われて待つ馬鹿がいるか！\nさあ、これで貴様は過去の英霊の力を\n授かっ: Who's waiting around because someone told them to wait? Come on, now you've received the power of past heroes! Move out!
m920066.待てッ！！ 魂を奪っているのはお前か！\n英霊の魂はお前達の様な邪悪な者達が\n: Wait! You're the one stealing the souls! Heroes' souls aren't power for the likes of you!
m920066.待て卑怯者ッ！！\n……くそ、何という逃げ足の速さだ。: Stop, coward!! …Damn, what swift feet you have.
m920066.必殺剣……そうか、師匠の魂を宿したんだね？\nだけど、星の心を解さない君では、\:
The ultimate sword… so it's housing the master's soul, huh?
But without the heart of the stars, you can't wield the technique properly!
m920066.慌てなさるなギャレット殿。\n武具の損傷度合いや兵たちの疲労も考えるのだ。\nこ: Calm yourself, Lord Garrett. Consider the condition of our arms and the troops' fatigue. We should regroup here first...
m920066.我が師の魂が、この手にあるのだ……！: My master's soul is now in my hands…!
m920066.我輩は、自らの力で、\n貴方の奥義を今から自分のものにします。: I will claim your technique as my own, using my own strength.
m920066.技は張り子とは違います！\nきちんと訓練し、経験を積み、弓の何たるかを\n知らな: Techniques aren't paper-mâché! You must train properly, gain experience, and truly understand what a bow is before you can master it!
m920066.攻守において共に両極の武人たちか……。\n個性的な仲間が皆いきいきとしている。\: Warriors on opposite ends of offense and defense... Such unique comrades, all so lively. Prince, you truly are a magnanimous commander.
m920066.敵、撤退しています。\nどうやら、勝てたようですね。:
The enemy is retreating.
Looks like we won.
m920066.敵はまたも英霊の力を利用しているようです！\n王子、慎重なご采配を！！: The enemy is once again exploiting the power of the Heroic Spirits! Prince, choose your tactics carefully!!
m920066.新たな英霊を見つけはしたが……違う。\nこれではないのだ……我輩が求める魂は……: I've found a new hero, but… No. This isn't it… The soul I seek…
m920066.星の心と己を重ね、互いを受け入れなくては\n必殺の剣に至ることはできないんだ。\: You have to align your heart with the star's and accept each other to reach the ultimate sword. Since you discarded your heart, you were losing from the start.
m920066.本来、英霊の魂を集め、\n自身の力として行使する事など、\n当然不可能なのだが…: Normally, gathering the heroic souls and wielding them as one's own power is, of course, impossible… but…
m920066.深追いは無用です、レシア殿。\n今は守ることの出来た仲間の命と、\n取り返せた英: No need to pursue, Lady Reshia. Let us rejoice in the lives we saved and the heroes' souls we reclaimed.
m920066.滅多打ちのボッコボコ……だと？\nおい、あんた……何を勘違いしてる？\nこの戦場: “Obliterate and beat them to a pulp,” you say? Hey, you… what are you thinking? All the destruction on this battlefield belongs to me.
m920066.無力化すれば、\n魂が自然と離れ、取り戻す事が出来るだろう。:
If we neutralize them,
the souls will naturally detach, and we can recover them.
m920066.特訓や努力をせずとも強くなれるというわけか。\n浅はかな考えではあるが、卑怯者に:
So you can become strong without training or effort.
It's a shallow view, but for a coward it's an enticing prospect.
m920066.王子、くれぐれも怪我のないよう……いえ、\n互いに致命傷とならないようお願いしま: Prince, please be careful not to get hurt… no, I mean let's make sure neither of us lands a fatal blow. Now, prepare for battle.
m920066.王子、貴方に申し出たいことがある。\n英霊の守り手として、一人の武人として、\n: Prince, I have a request. As a Guardian of Heroes, and as a warrior, please grant me permission to accompany you.
m920066.王子が敵でなくて良かった……。\nこれほどまでに強いとは……。\nだが、だからこ: I'm glad you're not the enemy, Prince… you're stronger than I imagined… That's exactly why it's worth serving you!
m920066.石碑が何者かの手によって壊されている！？\nあの石碑には英霊の魂が宿っているのに:
The stone monument has been shattered by someone!?
That monument held a heroic soul…
What on earth…
m920066.砲術の基礎も出来ていない者が、修行によって\n体得されるべき砲術の妙技を実践する: To think someone without even basic artillery training can wield such a refined cannon technique… The “Soul-Sucking Power” is truly terrifying.
m920066.私だけであろうと、英霊達の魂が\n安らかに眠れるよう、命に代えても\n敵を討ち払: Even if it's just me, I'm prepared to lay down my life so the heroic souls can rest in peace and to drive the enemy away.
m920066.私の名前はレシア。\n英霊の魂を守護する者だ。:
My name is Resia.
I am a guardian of the heroic souls.
m920066.私はレシア。\n英霊の魂を守護する者。:
I am Resia.
Guardian of heroic souls.
m920066.答えは単純さ。\nこのリカルドに、隙など一切無かったからだ！: The answer is simple. There wasn't a single opening against me!
m920066.美しい森をあんなやつらに汚させはしない。\n……王子、行こう。:
I won't let those bastards defile this beautiful forest.
…Prince, let's go.
m920066.良かった……。\nでも、魔物が『ダブルショット』を使ってたのが、\n気がかりだね:
That's a relief…
But it's worrying that the monster used “Double Shot”. What's that about?
m920066.英霊がもつ特技、つまりは\n『スキル』を使えるようになるのだ。: They gain the hero's special abilities, that is, they can use the “Skill”.
m920066.英霊たちの魂を取り戻すためにも、\n何としてでも敵を倒しましょう！\n王子、戦い:
To reclaim the heroes' souls, we must defeat the enemy at any cost!
Prince, prepare for battle!
m920066.英霊の魂を……！？\n詳しい話を聞かせてください。: Heroic souls…!? Please tell us more.
m920066.英霊の魂を奪う最も簡単な方法は、\n森にある石碑を破壊することだ。\n奴らはそれ:
The simplest way to steal a heroic soul is to destroy the stone monuments in the forest.
They repeat this mercilessly.
m920066.虚構といえど、あの暴威を止めることは\n容易いことではないだろう。あの力を前に、: Even though it's a fabrication, stopping that rampage won't be easy. That we suffered only this much damage before that power is a miracle.
m920066.観念しろ、デシウス。\n貴様の力への求道は、その進路を誤っている。\n果てには空: Accept it, Decius. Your relentless pursuit of power is on the wrong path. You already know the end holds only emptiness, don't you?
m920066.負け、ですか……しかし、後悔などありません。\n一瞬でも、私は『コキュートス』を: Lose, huh... But I have no regrets. Even if only for a moment, I got to wield Cocytus as my own power... So... that's enough.
m920066.負けてしまったカボ……。\n悔しいガボ……何で勝てないガボ……？: We lost… So frustrating… Why can't we win…?
m920066.貴方の言うとおりかもしれないな。\n少し、熱くなっていたようだ。\n助言、感謝す: You may be right. I got a bit carried away. Thank you for the advice.
m920066.貴方達のその偽りなき武技のきらめきで、\n引き続き協力を頼む。: With the brilliance of your genuine techniques, keep supporting us.
m920066.足跡の状態からみて、\nまだ敵は近くにいるみたいですね……。: Judging by the footprints, the enemy must still be nearby...
m920066.退散カボ！！\nこうなったら、もっともっと魂を集めるガボ！\nそして、もっともっ: Begone, Kabo!! Now I'll gather even more souls, Gabo! And then I'll dominate the world even more, Gabo!!
m920066.退路を確保していたか……。\nだが奴らの戦力も大分削がれている。\n追撃を続行し: You secured a retreat... But their forces have been whittled down considerably. We'll keep the pressure and drive them home!
m920066.逃げられてしまいましたね……残念です。\nせっかく魔力の根源へと至る新たな道を\: They've escaped… How disappointing. I thought they'd be the key to forging a new path to the source of magic…
m920066.遠距離からの砲撃によって\n前線の陣形が崩されていきます！: The enemy's long-range artillery is breaking our front lines!
m920066.魂ハコベ！ 沢山ハコベ！\n魂ハコベ！ 沢山ハコベ！: Soul harvest! Lots of harvest! Soul harvest! Lots of harvest!
m920066.黙れ……黙れ黙れ黙れぇェェえええ――ッ！\n我輩は間違わない……もう間違わんのだ: Shut up… shut up, shut up—! I won't be wrong… I won't be wrong any longer!
m920066.黙れ、英霊の守り手風情が言葉を向けるな！\n貴様らとの会話こそ虚言よ。\nさらば: Shut up, you so-called Guardian of Heroes! Don't you dare speak to me! Our conversation is nothing but lies. Farewell—!!

m920093.――そこまで！\n王子、兵の者達に\nお付き合いいただき、ありがとうございます。: ――That's all! Prince, thank you for joining the soldiers.
m920093.――て、敵兵の姿を確認！\n戦闘に入ります！: —— Enemy troops spotted! Engaging in battle!
m920093.――王子、ここの様ですよ、肝試し大会の会場は。\n何やら手伝ってほしい事があると: —Prince, this is the venue for the courage-test tournament. Metus said there's something they'd like us to help with…
m920093.――王子、こちらが水かけ大会の会場のようです。\nセノーテさんと水霊の舞いで、見: —Prince, this appears to be the venue for the water-splashing contest. With Cenote and the water-spirit dance, it'll be a cool summer festival that refreshes everyone's hearts.
m920093.――王子、見て下さい。立派な櫓ですね。\nフィリスさんと兵の皆さんで作られたとの:
—Prince, look. What a splendid tower.
I hear you and the soldiers built it together.
m920093.――皆さん祭りを楽しんでおられるようですね。\n……良い慰安となったようです。\:
――It seems everyone's enjoying the festival.
…It's been a nice morale boost.
All thanks to Phyllis and the soldiers' hard work.
m920093.……あら、バレちゃったかしら？\nお祭り事は楽しまないと損だしね。\nそれに、ダ: …Oh, did I get caught? You have to enjoy the festival, or you'll miss out. And darling's coming too, right? Can't wait ♪
m920093.……ありがとうアンナ。\nけど、兵達に怪我させてしまったのは、\n私の実力がなか: …Thank you, Anna. But the soldiers got hurt because I wasn't strong enough… It's my fault…
m920093.……いや、連携が失敗したのは皆のせいじゃない。\n部隊の足並みを揃える事が出来な: …No, the failed coordination isn't anyone else's fault. It's my fault for not keeping the unit in step.
m920093.……そうだ、フィリスさん。祭りを先導されるのなら、\nこちらの衣装に着替えられて:
…That's right, Phyllis. Since you're leading the festival,
why don't you change into this outfit?
I've prepared attire that's perfect for a summer festival.
m920093.……それだけです。\n王子の貴重なお時間を賜った事、\n感謝いたします。何卒ご配: …That's all. Thank you for sparing your precious time, Prince. We humbly ask for your consideration.
m920093.……ですが、皆の言う通りです。\nフィリスさん。次の連携訓練までに、\n兵達に指: …But, as everyone said, Phyllis, you just need to train until the next coordination drill so you can command the troops.
m920093.……中々、賑わってるみたいじゃない。\n余興に手を貸した甲斐もあったかしら。:
…It's pretty lively, isn't it?
All that extra help with the entertainment paid off, I think.
m920093.……兵の皆さん、いつもよりも元気がありますね。\nこれが夏祭り効果でしょうか。: …Everyone, you seem more lively than usual. Must be the summer festival effect.
m920093.……断るわ。私たちの銃は命の駆け引きを行う道具。\nそんな遊びで引き金を引くなん: …I refuse. Our guns are tools for life-or-death decisions. Using them for a game is like throwing away a pirate's pride.
m920093.……私はしっかりと指揮を執れなかった。\nそればかりか、怪我人まで出してしまって:
…I couldn't command properly.
On top of that, I even caused injuries…
I'm unfit to be a commander…
m920093.……自分達はフィリスさんが誰よりも努力してるのを\n知っています。この夏祭りも、:
…We know you work harder than anyone.
This summer festival happened because you were here!
m920093.……貴方たちの覚悟、伝わったわ。\n夏祭りの余興引き受けてあげる。: …I've felt your resolve. I'll take on the festival's side act for you.
m920093.あ、いたいた。\nフィリスさん、櫓の完成おめでとうございます！\n早速、踊りの練:
Ah, there you are.
Congratulations on finishing the tower, Phyllis!
Let's start practicing the dance right away!
m920093.あぁ、これなら王子もびっくりするだろうな。: Ah, the Prince will be amazed by this.
m920093.ああ、そうだな。もうすぐだ……\n……日が暮れれば、夏祭りが始まる。\n……みん: Yeah, that's right. It's almost time… When night falls, the summer festival will begin. I hope everyone enjoys it.
m920093.ああそうだ、\n私は皆と共にお祭りを楽しみたいんだ。\n……だから、無理はしない: Right… I want to enjoy the festival with everyone. So promise me you won't overdo it.
m920093.ああっ……ま、まだ前進の指示は\n出してないのに……。: Ah… I haven't even given the order to advance yet…
m920093.あっ、王子……見られてしまいましたか。\nまだ準備中の部分もあります故、\nしっ:
Ah, Prince… you saw it already?
There are still parts under construction, so we wanted to show it to you once everything was ready.
m920093.あっおい、フィリス！\nどこ行くんだ！？: Hey, Phyllis! Where are you going!?
m920093.あの……フィリスさん……僕たちは\nフィリス隊としてまた訓練を積みたいです。\n:
Um… Phyllis… We'd like to train again as the Phyllis Squad.
Would you lead us once more as our captain?
m920093.あの位置からは木陰が死角になるはずだから……\nそうだな、そこが良さそうだ。: From that spot the shade will be a blind spot… Yeah, that looks better.
m920093.あら、それは残念だわ。\nじゃあ、もっと怖くした方が良いかしらね～？: Oh, that's a shame. Then perhaps we should make it even scarier, hmm?
m920093.あら、フィリス隊の兵士じゃない。\n訓練の時の動きは酷かったし、夏祭りの準備より: Oh, it's not a soldier from Phyllis' squad. Their training was terrible, and before the festival prep, don't you have something else to do?
m920093.あら、逃げられちゃったわね。\nここの仕上げは私たちでやっておくから、\nダーリ: Oh, you ran off. We'll finish up here ourselves, so darling, go chase after Phyllis.
m920093.い、いやそれは……。ほ、ほら、せっかく王子に\nリハーサルもしてもらったのだ。こ: N-no, that's… Look, we finally got the Prince to do the rehearsal. Let's call it done and move on to preparing the next act!!
m920093.いえ、構いませんよ。王子、しっかりと汗をかいて、\n涼んできてください！ 応援し: No problem at all. Prince, work up a good sweat and cool off! We're cheering you on!
m920093.いよいよ夏祭り本番ですね。\n張り切って舞っちゃいますよ！: At last, the summer festival proper! I'm going to dance with all my might!
m920093.うぅ……メメント、ミネルバの部隊と\n同時に進むはずが、私一人に……。: Ugh… Memento, I was supposed to move together with Minerva's unit, but I'm on my own…
m920093.うう～ん。スケルトン３体だけじゃ\nサポート足りなかったかも。: Hmm… Three skeletons alone weren't enough support, I guess.
m920093.ええ、海賊たるもの二言はないわ。: Yes, a pirate never backs down.
m920093.えーっと。入場制限は２人までかな。\nあんまり大勢で来られてしまうと、\n驚きが: Umm… the entry limit is two people, right? If too many show up, the surprise won't be as big…
m920093.お、おい、お前たち！\n行ってしまった……。\n無理してるんじゃないか……。: Hey, you guys! You've already left… Aren't you pushing yourselves too hard?
m920093.お、王子も来ているのか……\nぐぅ……緊張で胸が張り裂けそうだ……。: Oh, the Prince is here too… Guh… I feel like my chest might burst from nerves…
m920093.おいおい。何そんなに辛気臭ぇ顔してんだ。\nそんな面してちゃ、兵達もついてこねぇ:
Hey, hey. Why the gloomy face?
If you keep that look, the troops won't follow you.
m920093.お祭りの準備は着々と進んでいるようですね。\nこれもフィリスさんと皆さんが、力を: The festival preparations seem to be progressing smoothly. That's thanks to you, Phyllis, and everyone working together.
m920093.く、訓練で怪我なんてしていません！\nあれは訓練が終わった後、\nうっかり転んで:
We didn't get injured during training!
That was just after it ended,
I just slipped by accident!
m920093.こ、ここ、怖いなどある訳ないだろう。\nままま、全く……。: N-no, there's no way this could be scary. I-I mean, honestly…
m920093.この夏祭りは兵達の慰安が目的なんだ。\nあまり変な事は考えないでくれよ。: The purpose of this summer festival is to give the troops some relief. So don't overthink it.
m920093.これからは無理せず、\n力を合わせて物事に当たっていきます。\n王子、フィリスさ: From now on we'll take things at a sensible pace, working together. Prince, Phyllis, thank you again!
m920093.すみません、早く夏祭りを始めたくて、\nつい見に来てしまいました。: Sorry, I was so eager to start the festival that I came to see it early.
m920093.せっかく王子にチャンスをもらったのに、\nふいにしてしまってすまなかった……。: I'm sorry I let the chance you gave me slip away…
