A group of angels is marching from beyond the pyramids,
heading straight for our position.
And they've brought reinforcements with them—
soldiers wielding abnormally large axes.
m920140.ボ、ボクとライチさんがライバルに……！？\nそれは嬉しいですけど……でもボク、\:
Me and Raichi as rivals...!?
That sounds nice... but I'm not really into sports, you see...
m920140.ボクはあっちみたいです。\nそういうライチさんは……？:
I think I'm on that side over there.
And you, Raichi?
m920140.ボクはライチさんのライバル、なんですよね？\nそれなら学園生活で、一緒に頑張るラ:
You're my rival, Raichi, right?
If so, I think it would be nice if we competed in all sorts of things
as rivals who work hard together during our time at the academy.
m920140.ボクは巻き込まれただけなんですけどね……？: I was just dragged into it, though…?
m920140.ミーシャ！ うん、ボクも最強目指して、\nちゃんと基礎を学び直そうかなって♪:
Mischa! Yes, I was thinking I'd properly relearn the basics
as I aim to become the strongest.
m920140.ユキヒメ、ボクたちの決着、\nちゃんと見届けてね。:
Yukihime, watch closely
to see how our rivalry ends.
m920140.ユキヒメさんのおやつがご褒美なら、\n頑張りがいもありそうですね。それじゃあライ:
If Yukihime's snacks are the reward,
I certainly have motivation to win. Then, Raichi,
the next time we meet, the dust will be settled!
m920140.ユキヒメのおべんとう……！\nぐぬぬ、ここは引き分けということで……。:
Yukihime's lunch……!
Grrr, let's call it a draw, then……
m920140.ライチさん、相手の指揮官には\nトトノさんがついてるのでご注意を。\n商人とはい:
Raichi, just a heads-up: Totono will be commanding the opposition.
Even though he's a merchant, he's someone who operates alongside the Royal Army.
m920140.ライチちゃんは、がんばり屋さんだから……。\nアンリちゃんもちょっと嬉しそうだっ:
Raichi-chan is such a hard worker...
I wonder if Henri-chan was a little pleased, too...?
m920140.三人とも、仲が良いみたいでなによりです。\nところで特訓ついでに、私の出し物の\:
It's wonderful to see the three of you getting along so well.
By the way, while you're at it, would you mind helping me
with some training for my performance?
m920140.三人分用意したから、大丈夫、だよ……？\nそれじゃあ一緒に、いたーだきます……♪:
I made enough for three, so it's fine, okay?
Then… let's eat together…♪
m920140.予定にはなかったけど、\n捕獲を手伝ってもらっていいかい……？:
It wasn't part of the plan, but
would you mind helping us capture it……?
m920140.今は情報を集めるしかありませんね。\n魔術師ギルドも、世界各地で天界の動向を探っ:
For now, all we can do is gather information.
The Mages' Guild is also monitoring the situation in the Heavens
across the world.
m920140.他には誰が入学してましたっけ。\n市民だけじゃなく、王国軍からも何人かいたような:
Who else enrolled, I wonder.
Besides the citizens, I think a few from the Kingdom's army came too...
m920140.体育祭……！！ よぉし、じゃあボク、\n体育祭の総合優勝目指しちゃうよ！: The sports festival...!! All right, then I'm going to aim for the overall championship!
m920140.体育祭のしおりくらい\nちゃんと読まないとだめですよ？\n最後の種目は……あっ、:
You should have read the sports day program
properly, shouldn't you?
The last event is…… ah, aaah!!
m920140.体育祭の出し物？ トトノは何をするの？: A performance for the sports festival? What are you doing, Totono?
m920140.体育祭の最中に屋台を出せば、\n絶対大当たりするとは思いましたけど、\nさすがに:
I figured setting up stalls during the sports festival
would definitely be a hit,
but I didn't expect it to get this crowded……
m920140.何をぉ！？ 俺はただ売り子さんが\n可愛いなぁって思ってだなぁ！？:
What!? I was just saying
the vendor is cute, that's all!
m920140.先輩たちに負けてなくても、\nライチさんに負けるのは、やっぱり悔しいです。\nそ:
Even if I didn't lose to the upperclassmen,
losing to Raichi is still frustrating.
It's just that…… we're rivals, so…….
m920140.入学早々勢い余ってる感じ、嫌いじゃないぜ。\nじゃあライチ、今度開かれる体育祭で:
I don't mind the enthusiasm right out of the gate.
How about this, Raichi? Why don't you compete against the other new students
at the upcoming sports festival?
m920140.分野は違えど偉大な技術者である、\nウェンディ先輩がエントリーしているんです……:
Senior Wendy, a great technician in her own field,
is entered in the race……!
m920140.判断材料は点数だけじゃないんですよ？\nライチさんはアンリさんと競いあう仲で、\:
The score isn't the only thing to consider, is it?
Raichi and Anri have been rivals, constantly pushing each other,
and they've both deepened their strategic and tactical knowledge…….
m920140.勉学でも運動でも根底は同じ。\nつまりは筋力、持久力です……！:
Whether it's academics or athletics, the foundation is the same.
In other words, it's muscle strength and stamina...!
m920140.勝ったほうに、ご褒美もお願いしますね♪: Please give the winner a reward, too♪
m920140.天使の動向はいつも不可解なものでしたが、\n天界で何が起きているのか分からないの:
The angels' movements have always been baffling,
but not knowing what is happening in the Heavens
makes it all the more unsettling……
m920140.学園の体育祭では、\n本物の戦闘さながらの模擬戦も行われます。\n参謀としての知:
The academy's sports festival also includes practice matches that mimic real combat.
I think it would be a good opportunity to test your strategic mind as a staff officer, too?
m920140.学年ＭＶＰは――ライチさん、アンリさん、\n同点で入賞です。おめでとうございます:
The Class MVP goes to—— Raichi and Anri,
tied for first place. Congratulations~ ♪
m920140.戦場において、それらがなくては優れた戦術も、\n磨いた技術も絶対に発揮されないの:
On the battlefield, without those, no amount of brilliant tactics or honed skill
will ever be put to use.
m920140.普段から戦場を巡ってる傭兵さん相手なら、\n充実した特訓ができる……かも……？:
If we're going up against mercenaries who live on the battlefield,
we might actually get a really solid workout……?
m920140.最後の種目まで少し時間があるから。\n美味しいものを食べて、ゆっくり休んでね。\:
There's still some time before the final event.
Eat something good and rest up.
Here, Anri, open wide~ ♪
m920140.望むところ！\nさぁ王子、さっそくこっちのチームの作戦会議だよ！:
Just as I hoped!
Come on, Prince, let's get started on the strategy meeting for our team!
m920140.模擬戦闘と陣形訓練を兼ねた、\nまったく新しい種目です。\n王子を真似て、私も軍:
It's a completely new event that combines mock combat with formation drills.
I've been thinking of trying my hand at commanding the legion, just like the Prince does.
m920140.模擬戦！ 模擬戦行く！！\nベルニスー！！ まぜてー！！:
A practice match! I'm in!
Bernice! Let me in!
m920140.次は障害物競走……なんですけど、\n王国軍から先輩方が多数参加してまして……。:
The next one is the obstacle course…… but,
many seniors from the Royal Army are participating…….
m920140.無事に捕獲できて良かったけど、\n追いかけ回してるうちにお腹減っちゃったね。:
I'm glad we caught it safely, but
chasing it around really worked up my appetite.
m920140.無敵の戦士目指して、がんばるぞー！: I'm going to work hard to become an invincible warrior!
m920140.王子、どうやらお腹をすかせた魔獣が、\nこちらに向かって走ってきているようです。:
Prince, it seems a hungry beast
is charging straight toward us.
m920140.王子、救援感謝します。\nおかげで天使の襲撃に、未然に対処できました。:
Prince, thank you for the rescue.
Thanks to you, we were able to deal with the angel attack before it escalated.
m920140.皆さん、準備はよろしいですか？\nそれでは王子、軍団指揮をよろしくお願いします！:
Everyone, are you ready?
Then, Prince, I leave the command of the troops to you!
m920140.直接指揮を受けている間、\n傭兵さん達の動きは普段以上のものになるはずです！:
While he's giving them direct orders,
expect the mercenaries to move far better than usual!
m920140.確かに、正規軍とは違う戦い方をするのですから、\n学ぶことは多いと思いますよ？:
Indeed. Since they fight differently from the regular army,
there's a lot we can learn from them, don't you think?
m920140.確かにこの辺りに、\nやけに濃い魔力の反応が残っています。\n天使がいたことだけ:
There is indeed a lingering,
unusually strong magical reaction in this area.
There's no doubt an angel was here.
m920140.私はおべんと、作るね……？\nひやひや冷たいデザートも作るよ。:
I'll make some bento...?
And some nice, cold desserts, too.
m920140.私も応援するから……頑張ってね……♪: I'll be cheering you on too…… Do your best……♪
m920140.筆記試験一位！？\n一番……一番かぁ……ぐぬぬ、羨ましい……。:
A perfect score on the written exam!?
First place... First place... Grr, I'm jealous...
m920140.羨ましいって言ったって、\nライチは魔法と近接戦闘の成績中々だったじゃないか。\:
Jealousy won't change anything,
but Raichi did quite well in magic and close-quarters combat.
Everyone has their own strengths, you know?
m920140.良い子の皆は応援を頼むぜ！\nそれじゃあディエーラ、王子、準備はいいかい？:
Good kids, I'll be counting on your cheers!
Now then, Diela, Prince, are you ready?
m920140.良かった、それじゃあ傭兵さん達を呼んできますね。\n訓練のお相手、よろしくお願い:
Wonderful. I'll go fetch the mercenaries, then.
Thank you in advance for being our sparring partners.
m920140.野生の魔物を簡単にぶった斬っていやがった。\n何しろあんなデカイ斧だ、\n受け止:
They were cleaving through wild monsters like they were nothing.
With axes that big,
just blocking one would probably numb your whole body……
m920140.開会セレモニーでは、王国軍、学園合同で、\n王子による軍団指揮のお披露目が行われ:
As part of the ceremony, the Royal Army and the Academy will join forces
for a demonstration of the Prince's command abilities.
Athletes, please proceed to your respective positions.
m920140.陣形訓練を同時に行うことで、\n乱戦になりがちな模擬戦と比べ、\nより実際の戦場:
By running formation drills at the same time, it allows for a more realistic group engagement
than a typical free-for-all mock battle.
m920140.順番……だよ？ はい、ライチちゃんもあーん♪: We take turns…… okay, Raichi, open wide~ ♪
m920140.魔獣さんたち、美味しそうに串焼き食べてますねぇ。\nうぅ、ボクもおなか空いてきち:
The beasts are eating their skewers so nicely.
Ugh, I'm getting hungry too……
m920140.（このふたり、真逆なのにどこか似てますねぇ……）: (These two are complete opposites, and yet… somehow, they're a lot alike…)

m920177.…………別に嫌とは、言ってませんけど。: ...I never said I didn't want to.
m920177.……おいおいお嬢さんよ、\nそれはオレたちに言ったのか？:
……Hey, miss,
were you talking to us?
m920177.……それは聞き方がズルいでしょう。: ...That's a bit of a trick question.
m920177.……ところでヨシノ、\nどうしてコマちゃんを花嫁に選んだの？\n白無垢の普及が目:
...By the way, Yoshino,
why did you choose Koma-chan as the bride?
If the goal is to popularize white wedding dresses, there were other candidates, weren't there?
m920177.……ふぅ、本当に逃げましたか。\nあと少しで首が落とせそうでしたが、\nさすがに:
……Phew, they really did escape.
I was so close to taking their heads off, but
I suppose I shouldn't expect it to be that easy.
m920177.……むむ？ コマちゃんに、ユーティさん？\n二人ともこんな場所でどうなされたので:
...Hm? Koma-chan and Utty?
What are you two doing in a place like this?
m920177.……コマちゃん、\n狛犬キックの解放を許可します。\n存分に蹴散らしてあげなさい:
...Koma-chan,
I authorize the release of the Komainu Kick.
Kick them all to the curb.
m920177.……何故私が選ばれたのかは知りません。\nですが私はキョンシー、一度死んだ身です:
...I don't know why I was chosen.
But I am a jiangshi. I am already dead.
There are surely many others more suited to the role of a bride.
m920177.……実は結婚式の多いこの季節を狙ってなのか、\n小人たちによる花嫁の誘拐事件が多: ...The fact is, with the wedding season in full swing, there's been a spike in bride kidnappings by dwarves.
m920177.……狛犬とは魔除けの守護獣。\n魔を拒む力が、あるそうですね？:
……A Komainu is a guardian beast that wards off evil.
It seems to have the power to repel magic?
m920177.……私も噂でしか聞いたことはないのですが、\n私たちの業界でも特に有名な悪い魔女:
……I've only heard rumors about her, but
she's one of the most notorious witches in our line of work.
They say she once destroyed an entire small country……
m920177.──あっ！ 王子王子！\n王子も準備できたんですね！: ──Oh! Prince, Prince! You're all ready too!
m920177.──おや、皆さんお揃いでどうしました？: ──Oh, what brings you all here together?
m920177.──そこまでです！\n全員武器を捨て両手を上に！\n指示に従わない場合は攻撃しま:
──That's enough!
Everyone, drop your weapons and raise your hands!
I won't hesitate to fire if you don't comply!
m920177.──なんだい小人どもが騒がしいと思ったら。\nケケケ、想像以上の大物が釣れてるじ:
──I wondered what all the fuss was about.
Hehehe, we've caught a much bigger fish than I expected.
m920177.──まったくもう、\n花嫁衣装でなにしてんだか。\nすっかり仲良くなっちゃって。: ──Honestly, what are you doing in a wedding dress? You've all become such good friends.
m920177.──ッ！ 大変です！ コマちゃんさんが攫われました！: ──! It's bad! Koma-chan has been kidnapped!
m920177.──ッ！？ 大魔女マズゥ……！\nあなたがこの事件の黒幕だったのね！:
──!? The Great Witch, Mazu……!
So you were the mastermind behind all of this!
m920177.──小人事件の数日前。: (narration) ──A few days before the incident involving the little people.
m920177.──結構です。今、とても忙しいので。: ──No, thank you. I'm rather busy at the moment.
m920177.──耳障りです。口を閉じてください、三下。: ──You're grating. Shut your mouth, you lowlife.
m920177.あ、あたしの魔術が……\nこんな犬っころにぃぃぃぃいッ！:
A-And my magic is……
By this little doggy?!
m920177.ああ、あれが例の事件を起こしている小人だ。\n警戒していたつもりだが警備網の間隙:
Aye, that's the dwarf responsible for the incident.
I thought we had it covered, but it slipped through a gap in our security.
m920177.ああ悪い、脅かすつもりはないんだ。\n幸いまだそれほど大きな被害は出ていない。\:
Ah, I'm sorry, I didn't mean to scare you.
Fortunately, the damage hasn't been too severe so far.
Everyone who was taken has been rescued quickly.
m920177.あっ、あの！ コマもお手伝いしたいです！: Ah, that's right! I'd like to help too!
m920177.あっ、それわかります。\nコマちゃんが狛犬だからでしょうか、\n悪いものが吹き飛:
Oh, I know that feeling.
It's probably because Koma-chan is a guardian lion.
It feels like the bad stuff just blows away!
m920177.あっ、コマちゃんが歌ってる。カワイイ。: Oh, Koma-chan is singing. How cute.
m920177.あっはっは、それは簡単な話だよ。\n敗北の屈辱を雪げるのは勝利の美酒のみ。\nも:
Ahaha, that's an easy one.
The only thing that washes away the shame of defeat is the sweet nectar of victory.
Why not just run another simulation battle?
m920177.あっ！ 待ちなさい！ 逃がしませんよ！: Ah! Wait! We're not letting you escape!
m920177.あの人たちもコマちゃんの手前ですし、\n本当に危なくなったら止めるでしょう、多分:
For Koma-chan's sake, and since they're here,
they'll probably stop if things get really dangerous.
m920177.あら本当。でもこれだと起こすのが忍びないわね。\n今日中に王国に出発しないと間に:
Oh, really. But I can't bear to wake her up.
We need to set out for the Kingdom today, or we'll be too late.
m920177.ありがとうね。私たちは祝祭の準備で\n持ち場を離れられないから任せきりになるけど:
Thank you. We can't leave our posts to prepare for the festival,
so we're leaving it entirely up to you.
Please take care of Bernice and Furon.
m920177.あれ、コマちゃん？ どこですかー？: Wait, Koma-chan? Where did you go?
m920177.いいですか、コマちゃん。\nパンチは腰の回転がとても重要です。\n狙いを澄まし最: Now then, Koma-chan. The rotation of your waist is crucial for a punch. Focus your aim and strike the shortest path.
m920177.いえ、迅速な対応だったと思います。\nさすがは歴戦の王国軍兵士長ですね。:
Not at all. You handled it swiftly.
You really live up to your reputation as a veteran captain of the royal army.
m920177.いけません！？ 王子だけでも外に──: No! At least the Prince should get out──
m920177.いだっ！ いだだだッ！？\nやめっ、やめないかこの犬っころ！\n老人は労われって:
Ouch! Ouch, ouch!
Stop it! Stop it, you little dog!
Didn't anyone teach you to respect your elders?!
m920177.いや、さすがにこの面子は……（ちらり）: Well, with this lineup, I suppose... (glances sideways)
m920177.いやぁ、大変でしたねコマちゃ──: Oh, that was quite a scare, Koma-chan──
m920177.うぇぇぇん！ 王子ぃ、怖かったよぉ！: Waaah! Prince, that was so scary!
m920177.うぇへへ……コマはお役立ちの狛犬……むにゃ。: Whehe... Koma is a helpful komainu... mmm.
m920177.うるせぇバーカ！ 早くコマちゃん返せ！: Shut up, you idiot! Give Koma-chan back right now!
m920177.う～ん、コマちゃんだから無罪！: Well, I guess it's a free pass since it's Koma-chan!
m920177.え、だってカワイイじゃん、コマちゃん。: Huh? But Koma-chan is cute, isn't she?
m920177.えぇぇ……フーロンさんて意外と──じゃなくて、\n緊急事態です……急いで王城の方:
Ehh…… Hu-Long-san is surprisingly── no, that's not it.
It's an emergency…… We need to head back to the royal castle right away.
m920177.ええい、もう頭に来た！\nこんなところにいられるかい！\nあたしは家に帰らせても:
Ugh, I'm losing my patience!
I'm not staying here!
I'm going home!
m920177.ええっ！？ とっ、とりあえず対処しないと！: What!? I-I need to deal with this first!
m920177.ええと……あれはスプリガンですね？\n小人に化けていたとは、ユーティびっくり。:
Oh my... That's a spriggan, isn't it?
I'm surprised it was disguising itself as a dwarf.
m920177.ええと……それがユーティたちと何の関係が？: Um... and how does that relate to Utty and the others?
m920177.ええと、まずは小人さんたちですね。\n彼らはスプリガンに利用されているだけです。:
First, there are the Dwarves.
They're simply being used by the Spriggans.
They were told that if they held a wedding, they'd get a feast.
m920177.ええと、一応理由を聞いても……？: Um, may I ask for your reasons...?
m920177.えっと、コマは何もされてないので、\nあんまり怖いことはしないでほしいなって……:
Um, since Koma-chan hasn't done anything,
I'd appreciate it if you wouldn't do anything too scary…….
m920177.えっとぉ……もしかしなくても、\nジューンブライドの祝祭のことですか？:
Um... could it be that you're here
about the June Bride Festival?
m920177.えへへ……そういうことです。\nぶしつけな質問かもしれませんが、\nどうして花嫁:
Ehehe... it is.
It might be a bit forward, but
why did you decide to decline the role of the bride?
m920177.えへへ……そういうことなのであれば、\nユーティはぜひご協力させていただきたく。:
Ehehe... if that's the case,
Utty would be more than happy to help.
m920177.えへへ……コマちゃんを泣かせる悪い子には、\nユーティもちょーっぴり、本気出しち:
Ehehe…… If you're going to make Koma-chan cry,
I'll have to show you just how serious I can be, okay?
m920177.えへへ……大船に乗ったつもりでお任せです。\nそれでは早速頑張りましょうね、コマ:
Ehehe... I'll leave it in your capable hands.
Well then, let's get started, Koma-chan.
m920177.えへへ……次はフーロンさん……いました！: Ehehe... Next is Hu-Long... She's here!
m920177.えへへ……素直になった方が楽ですよ？: Ehehe... It's easier to be honest, isn't it?
m920177.えへへ！ コマはお役立ちの狛犬なので！: Ehehe! Koma-chan is a very useful Komainu!
m920177.おい、貴重な研究材料じゃ、加減には気をつけい。: Hey, that's valuable research material. Watch your manners.
m920177.おお、そこの娘の父親はな、\n化境に至るだけの素質を持ちながら、\n女のために武:
Oh, that girl's father had the potential to reach the pinnacle of cultivation,
yet he abandoned the path of martial arts for a woman. A half-baked fool.
m920177.おそらくカワイイ！ おそらくカワイイがいる！: Probably cute! There's probably a cute one here!
m920177.おそらくコマちゃんはそこに囚われているのかと……。: Komachan is probably being held prisoner there……
m920177.おや、お前さんはコキュートスの小娘かい。\nははぁ、見ない内に随分大きくなったも:
Oh my, isn't that the little girl from Cocytus?
Hahaha, you've grown quite a lot since I last saw you.
m920177.おやおや、そこの綺麗なお嬢さん。\nこんな雨の中に傘も差さずにどうしたんだい？\:
My, my. What a lovely young lady.
What are you doing out in the rain without an umbrella?
Why not take shelter with us for a while?
m920177.かけっこ自慢に人形趣味の変態爺。\n王子に怯えてコソコソするしか能の無い、\n邪:
A braggart who boasts about his running speed and has a creepy hobby of collecting dolls.
I've heard he's a disgrace to Xie Xian Xiang, good for nothing but cowering in fear of the Prince.
m920177.くそぉ！ 何回結婚式をやり直しても、\n絶対に誓いの言葉で失敗しちまうだべ！:
Dammit! No matter how many times we redo this wedding,
I always mess up the vows!
m920177.くっ……そっがァ！ キョンシー風情が……！: Grrr…… You…… A jiangshi like you……!
m920177.こっ、コウメちゃん！ コウメちゃんは、\nコマと一緒に戦ってくれますよね！？ ね:
K-Koume-chan! Koume-chan,
you'll fight alongside Koma, right? Right?
m920177.こっ、コマも！ コマもお手伝いします！: K-Koma will help too! Koma will lend a hand!
m920177.このしろむくっていう衣装も、\nとってもきれいでお気に入りです！:
This shiro-muku outfit is
really pretty, and I love it!
m920177.このまま輿に乗せたら大丈夫でしょ。\n一度寝たら中々起きないってコウメちゃん言っ:
Just put her in the palanquin and we'll be fine.
Koume-chan said once she falls asleep, it's hard to wake her up.
Come on, Koma-chan. Let's spread white wedding dresses to the world!
m920177.この薬は未完成だから使いたくなかったけどね、\nここまでコケにされちゃあ、黙って:
I didn't want to use this potion since it's still unfinished, but...
after being treated like a joke like that, I can't just sit here and take it!
m920177.これが狛犬キック……！ なんて威力なの……！: So that's the Komainu Kick...! What power...!
m920177.さぁて？ 追い詰められたのはどっちだろうね？: Oh? I wonder who's really cornered here?
m920177.さあ、小人さんたち。\n大人しくしてくださいね。\nみなさんには黙秘権が──:
Now then, Dwarves.
Please behave yourselves.
You have the right to remain silent──
m920177.さあ、追い詰めましたよ！ 観念してください！: There! We've cornered you! Give up!
m920177.さて、どうやら釣りには成功したようですが……。: Well, it seems the bait worked……
m920177.しかし、ちっとばかし数が多いねぇ。\nここは一旦トンズラした方が良さそうだ。:
However, there are quite a few of you.
I think it's best if I slip away for now.
m920177.じゃあ、王子の隣で歩きたいのですか？: Then do you want to walk beside the Prince?
m920177.すぐに応援が来るはずです！ 応戦しましょう！:
Reinforcements should be arriving soon! Let's defend ourselves!
--- scene: Bridal Attire and Bait Investigation (battle, end) ---
m920177.すまん遅れた！ 三人とも無事か！？: Sorry I'm late! Are you three all right!?
m920177.せーむかんさんが、今日はこの辺にいるって──あっ！: Semukan said she'd be around here today──Ah!
m920177.ぜんぶコマにおまかせぇ……むにゃむにゃ。: Leave everything to Koma... mmm mmm.
m920177.そう、その調子ですよコマちゃん！\n遠慮せずガンガン打って来てください！: That's it, keep it up, Koma-chan! Don't hold back, hit as hard as you can!
m920177.そう、マリッジブルー。\nジューンブライドに関する文献を調べていたら、\n偶然そ:
That's right, marriage blue.
I was looking into some literature about June brides and
happened to come across a mention of it.
m920177.そうか……事件の被害者たちが、\n外傷は無いのに異様に衰弱していたのは、\nあの:
I see... The victims of the incident had no visible injuries, yet they were abnormally weakened.
It must be because that witch was draining their life force!
m920177.そうか？ 本来は私たちで解決すべき問題だが、\n今は犬の手も借りたい状況だからあ:
Really? This is normally a matter for us to handle,
but we could use all the help we can get right now.
All right, then there's something I'd like to ask the three of you.
m920177.そこで同じく花嫁役に選ばれたお二人に、\n彼女たちの説得をお願いしたいと思いまし:
So, I'd like to ask the two of you, who were also selected as brides,
to try and talk them out of it.
m920177.そしてあら不思議、こんなところに我が国の猛者が。: And look, what a stroke of luck. A fierce warrior from our own country, right here.
m920177.そっ、そんな……コマちゃん！\nなして、なしてオラじゃ駄目なんだべ！？\nこんな:
No, no way…… Koma-chan!
Why, why won't you choose me?!
I love you so much! I really, really do!
m920177.そっ、そんなことはないとコマは……。\nだってフーロンさん、すごくカワイイのに─:
I-I wouldn't say that...
After all, Hu-Long, you're so cute──
m920177.そっ、そんな馬鹿なことがあるかい！？\nここはあたしが何年も育て続けた工房だよ！:
W-What? That can't be!
This is a workshop I've been cultivating for years!
Unless you have some powerful anti-magic item──
m920177.その証拠に、王国全土に呪いが仕掛けられていたの。\n嫌がらせ程度の威力だから今ま:
As evidence, a curse had been placed across the entire Kingdom.
Its power was slight enough that we hadn't noticed it until now,
but it's a curse designed to make the target feel depressed.
m920177.その隙にお味方は本陣を攻められ敗北。\n勝利を目前で逃した指揮官のシナトさんは憤:
Taking advantage of that opening, the enemy attacked the main camp and we suffered a defeat.
Commander Shinato, who had victory within reach, died of a broken heart.
Ever since, Koma-chan has been in such a slump.
m920177.それじゃあコマちゃんを輿に乗せて……出荷っ！: Then let's put Koma-chan in the palanquin... and ship her out!
m920177.それにしてもコマちゃんは大活躍でしたね。\n鎧じゃ呪いは防げませんから、大助かり:
Still, Koma-chan really came through.
Armor can't stop curses, so that was a huge help.
m920177.それは……私には花嫁役なんて分不相応ですから……。: That's... the role of the bride is simply beyond my station...
m920177.そろそろ本題に入ってもいいかしら？\nみんなの調査結果や捕虜からの聴取を総合して:
Shall we get down to business?
Based on everyone's investigations and the interrogations of the prisoners,
it appears three different factions are involved in this incident.
m920177.ただおかしな点が幾つかあってな……\nベルニス、お前は二人を守ってやってくれ。\:
There are a few oddities, though...
Bernice, please keep an eye on the two of them.
We don't know when another attack might come.
m920177.ちょちょちょ！？ コマちゃんは私の！\nうちの子ですから引き抜こうとしないで！:
W-W-Wait?! Koma-chan is MINE!
She's my child, so don't try to poach her!
m920177.ですが一つだけ訂正させてください。\nジューンブライドは新郎新婦が主役です。\n:
But please allow me one correction.
In a June wedding, the bride and groom are the main characters.
What matters most is that the two of them feel happy.
m920177.でも、もし少しでも嫌じゃないのなら、\nコマはフーロンさんとお祭りに出たいです。:
But if there's even a little part of you that isn't opposed to it,
I really want to go to the festival with you.
m920177.でも、ベルニスさんはカワイイですよ？: But, Bernice-san, you're cute, you know?
m920177.とっ、突然でっかい人がー！？: Wha, a giant person just appeared out of nowhere!?
m920177.どれ、わしが有効活用して──: Let me see how I can put this to good use──
m920177.なっ、なしてここがバレたんだべ！？: Wh-What? How did they find us here?!
m920177.なるほどのぉ、面白い力よ。\nおぬし、確か名をコマと言ったか。\nどうじゃ、我の:
I see, I see. An interesting power, indeed.
You are Koma, were you?
How about it? Come visit my shrine?
m920177.なんか小人さんがたくさん襲って来ますー！？: A whole bunch of dwarves are swarming in!
m920177.なんだい爺さん、知ってるのかい？: What's with you, old man? Do you know about her?
m920177.なんにせよ、雨降って地固まるね。\n今回の人選は少し冒険かもって思ったけど──: Well, the storm has passed. I thought our choice of staff was a bit risky, but──
m920177.はい、ベルニスさんは鎧姿のままでも\nとっても素敵な女性で──誰ですか今の？: Yes, Bernice-san is a wonderful woman even in full armor, and── Who was that just now?
m920177.はいはい、会議でふざけないの。\nまずはコマちゃんの救出が先決よ。:
Enough already, don't joke around in a meeting.
Rescuing Komachan is our top priority.
m920177.はっはァ！ 死体の分際で吠えるじゃないか！\n──あんまり舐めたこと言うと蹴り殺:
Hah! A corpse has the nerve to bark!
──Say something like that again and I'll kick your head off!
m920177.はてさて、ここからどうやって帰りましょうか……。: I wonder how I'm supposed to get back from here……
m920177.ははッ、美人はツレないねぇ。\nそこの爺さんがキミに話があるらしい。\n少しばか:
Haha, you're a tough one, aren't you?
That old man over there says he wants a word with you.
Would you mind giving us a few minutes?
m920177.はーい、コマちゃんはあっち行きましょうねー。: Alrighty, Koma-chan, let's go over there.
m920177.ふぅ……なんとか撃退に成功しました。\n小人の帽子も順調に集まっていますね。:
Phew…… We managed to repel them.
We're making good progress collecting the dwarves' hats, too.
m920177.ふぇぇえ！？ お話の途中なのにぃ！？: Feee!? We weren't even finished talking!?
m920177.ふぇ！？ かか、カワイイだなんてそんな──！？: Feh!? C-cute... I've never been called that before!
m920177.ふふっ、今日も鬼切が血に飢えているわ……。: Fufu... Oni-Giri is hungry for blood again today...
m920177.まあ、撃退できただけでも良しとしましょう。\nそれよりも、取り急ぎ解決すべき問題:
Well, let's just be glad we managed to drive them off.
More importantly, the problem I need to solve right away is──
m920177.まずは……ベルニスさんからですね？: First... let's start with Bernice, shall we?
m920177.まずは何があったのか心配してあげなさい！\nというか、コマちゃんは本当にどうした:
First of all, you should be worried about what happened to her!
Honestly, what's going on with Koma-chan?
m920177.まだ他にも隠れているかもしれません！\n周囲に警戒しながら、冷静に対処しましょう:
There might be more hiding around!
Stay alert and handle this calmly!
m920177.もう手遅れさ！ あんたらの命、\nあたしのために使わせてもらうよ！: Too late! I'm going to use your lives for my own purposes!
m920177.やめい迅天君！ ここは一旦退くのじゃ！: Stop it, Jinten! We need to retreat for now!
m920177.わぁ、本当に速いんですね！ に・げ・あ・し！: Whoa, you're really fast! Run, run, run!
m920177.わふっ！？ なっ、なんでですかー！？: Wuff!? W-Why would they do that!?
m920177.わふ？ ベルニスさん、とっても似合ってますよ！: Wuff? Bernice, you look absolutely stunning!
m920177.んんっ！？ いえ、それは、その……！: H-Huh!? No, I mean, it's just that...!
m920177.カッカッカ！ 珍しい個体がいると噂には聞いていたが、\nなるほどのぉ、こやつあの:
Ka-ka-ka-ka! I heard there was a rare specimen around.
So that's it, huh? That creature is the man's daughter…… How amusing!
m920177.カワイイだー！ みんなー！ カワイイがいたぞー！: Cute! Everyone! There's something cute over here!
m920177.ケーキを作ってあげたら泣いて喜んでましたから、\n本当にご馳走にしか興味がなかっ: When I made them a cake, they cried with joy. It seems they were only interested in the feast after all……
m920177.コマたちには囮捜査をしてもらって、\nできるだけ多く小人の帽子を集めてほしい。\:
Koma, I'd like you to act as bait in this investigation.
Please gather as many dwarf hats as you can.
That should be the key to solving this case.
m920177.コマちゃん、コマちゃん。\n私の城にきたら毎日三食昼寝付き、\nおやつもいっぱい:
Koma-chan, Koma-chan.
If you come to my castle, you'll have three meals a day with naps in between,
and you can eat as many snacks as you want, okay?
m920177.コマちゃん、帝国に興味はないかい？: Koma-chan, are you not interested in the Empire?
m920177.コマちゃん、疲れたらお水もありますからねー。: Koma-chan, if you get tired, there's water here too, you know.
m920177.コマは、罰する価値すらないのですね～……。: So Koma isn't even worth punishing~...
m920177.コマはね、フーロンさんの事情は分からないけど、\nフーロンさんが王子の隣なんて絶:
I don't know what's going on with you, Hu-Long,
but if you absolutely don't want to walk beside the Prince,
I'll have to accept that, even if it's a shame.
m920177.ジューンブライドを前にした花嫁の中には、\n極度の不安や憂鬱に陥ってしまう者も少:
It seems that quite a few brides facing a June wedding
fall into extreme anxiety or depression.
The old folks used to call that marriage blue.
m920177.スプリガンに誘拐されたコマちゃんを探しに来たはずが、\nまさにミイラ取りがミイラ:
I came here to find Komachan, who was kidnapped by a Spriggan,
but it seems I've become the one in trouble. Oh, wait, I'm a jiangshi, so……
m920177.スプリガンは確かに狡賢い怪物だけど、\n王国の警備の目を欺くほどの力はないのよ。:
The Spriggans are certainly cunning monsters, but
they lack the power to deceive the Kingdom's security forces.
There must be a mastermind pulling the strings behind the scenes.
m920177.ディエーラに頼んでおいた花嫁衣装も、\n今日中には納品される予定みたいだし、\n:
The bridal gowns I had Diela make are
supposed to be delivered by the end of today,
so it's not too late to change their minds after a fitting.
m920177.トラブルもありましたが、\n良くも悪くも、昨日は昨日です。\nまた、新しい一日が: There were some troubles, but for better or worse, yesterday is yesterday. A new day begins.
m920177.フィリスさん、私たちは全員大丈夫です。\nそれよりあれが、今朝の朝礼で言っていた:
Phyllis, we're all fine.
More importantly, is that what you were talking about at the morning briefing?
m920177.フーロンさんは、王子とお祭りに出たくないのですか？: Does Hu-Long not want to go to the festival with the Prince?
m920177.フーロンさん！ あのね、コマはね、\nフーロンさんに花嫁さんになってほし──:
Hu-Long! So, um, Koma wants
you to be the bride──
m920177.フーロンさーん！ はぁ、はぁ、\nやっと見つけましたよ……！:
Hu-Long-san! Haa, haa,
I finally found you……!
m920177.ユーティさん、よくここが分かりましたね。\nちなみに私はここが何処だか分かりませ:
Utty-san, you found me quickly.
By the way, I have no idea where we are.
m920177.ユーティさんユーティさん！\nコマはみなさんとお祭りに出られるの、\nすっごくす:
Utty-san, Utty-san!
I'm so, so, so happy that I get to go to the festival with everyone!
m920177.不安になる気持ちも理解できるけどね。\nあの子たちの場合はそのまま辞退しちゃった:
I can understand why they'd feel anxious.
But if they just back out like that,
I think they'll definitely regret it later.
m920177.今は雌伏の時、無駄に力を使うでない。: Now is the time to lie low. Don't waste your strength.
m920177.今年もなんとかジューンブライドの祝祭の\n開催に無事漕ぎ着けることができましたね: Well, we managed to pull it off again. The June Bride Festival is finally underway……
m920177.付喪神って妖怪なのかしら？\n一度戦ってみたかったのよね。:
Are tsukumogami considered youkai?
I've always wanted to fight one.
m920177.何か、嫌な予感が……。:
I have a bad feeling about this...
--- scene: Bridal Attire and Bait Investigation (battle, start) ---
m920177.分かっておるわい、その上でじゃ。\n収穫はあった、あれはもう放っておけ。:
I know, I know. That's exactly why.
We got what we came for. Leave that one alone.
m920177.吐いた！？ 汚い！ 汚い！: He threw up?! Gross! So gross!
m920177.喧嘩を売る相手を間違えましたね。\n王子、コマちゃんの方をお願いします。:
You picked the wrong people to provoke.
Prince, please handle Koma-chan.
m920177.好きなのは確かでしょうが、\nコマちゃんを怖がらせている時点で、\n愛してるとは:
You might like her, sure,
but if you're scaring her like that,
I don't think you can really say you love her……
m920177.好機です！ みなさん攻撃準備を！\nさあ、コマちゃん！ 号令をどうぞ！:
Now's our chance! Everyone, get ready to attack!
Come on, Koma-chan! Give the signal!
m920177.妬ましいねぇ、憎たらしいねぇ。\n結婚式だなんだとはしゃぐあんたらも、\nあたし:
How jealous I am, how hateful you are.
Just like you, celebrating a wedding and all,
every single person in this world who never loved me.
m920177.妻子を病で亡くしたと聞いたが、\nまさかキョンシーにしていたとはのぉ。\nだが、:
I heard he lost his wife and child to illness.
To think he turned them into jiangshi……
Still, it's a well-crafted piece for an amateur.
m920177.始まっちゃう？ コマちゃん最強伝説。: Here it comes? The Legend of Koma-chan's Invincibility.
m920177.姫様、こいつ泣いてますよ。\nどうします？ 処しちゃいます？:
Princess, this one is crying.
What do we do? Should we just execute it?
m920177.姫様、どうにかなりませんかね？\n今朝もご飯をおかわりしなかったんです。:
Your Highness, is there anything we can do?
She didn't even ask for seconds at breakfast this morning.
m920177.実は今年のジューンブライドの祝祭ですが、\n花嫁役に選ばれたベルニスさんとフーロ:
It just so happens that for this year's June Bride Festival,
Bernice and Furon, who were chosen as the brides,
recently came forward to say they'd like to step down...
m920177.小人さん、帽子を落としながら帰ってしまいました。\nあれは何だったのでしょう……:
The dwarves dropped their hats and ran away.
What on earth was that... Could it be that I'm dreaming?
m920177.小人さんたちを雇用できたのも良かったですよ。\n賠償金を支払えないから労働力を提: It's a good thing we were able to hire the Dwarves, too. Since they couldn't pay the compensation, they offered their labor instead. They've been working harder than expected, so we're on track for a solid profit.
m920177.小人の帽子に残された魔術の痕跡から、\nほぼ全ての小人の拠点を発見、摘発してある:
Based on the magical traces left on the Dwarves' hats,
we've located and raided nearly all their bases.
Only one location remains, which we believe is their headquarters.
m920177.小人魂を見せてやれー！: Show us your true dwarf spirit!
m920177.幸せそうな新郎新婦を見て、周囲も嬉しくなる。\nそれこそがジューンブライドの本質:
When the bride and groom look happy, everyone around them feels happy too.
I think that's the true essence of a June bride.
m920177.強引に誘拐しておいてどの口が。: What a nerve, after kidnapping her.
m920177.役立たず～、役立たず～。\nコマは役立たずの狛犬～。:
Useless~... useless~.
Koma is a useless Komainu~.
m920177.彼女は永遠の美貌を求めて、\n数多の女性を手に掛けた大魔女よ！\nおそらくあれは:
She is a great witch who has claimed countless women in her pursuit of eternal beauty!
That must be it──an elixir of youth!
m920177.急に元気に！？ こらっ、待ちなさーい！: Suddenly full of energy? Hey, wait!
m920177.悪いな、援護が遅れちまった。: Sorry about that. I was late to back you up.
m920177.我が国の国宝が誘拐されたと聞いて。: I hear our national treasure has been kidnapped.
m920177.指図するな爺さん。オレはアンタの部下じゃない。\nアンタの言う天雷がオレの仙術に:
Don't tell me what to do, old man. I'm not your subordinate.
I'm only cooperating temporarily because you said your heavenly lightning would be useful for my immortal arts. Don't forget that.
m920177.捜査のご協力、感謝致します。\nあとはこちらに任せてください。\nベルニス、皆さ:
Thank you for your cooperation in the investigation.
Please leave the rest to us.
Bernice, I'm counting on you to look after everyone.
m920177.敗北の言い訳を考えておくことをオススメしますよ。\n貴方たちは今から、その半端者:
I suggest you start thinking up excuses for your defeat.
You're about to lose to the skills of that half-baked amateur.
m920177.数が多いです！ みなさん警戒をお願いします！: There are so many of them! Everyone, stay alert!
m920177.断固としてお断りします。人を探しているんです。\n今この瞬間にもコマちゃんは泣い:
I refuse, point blank. I'm looking for someone.
Koma-chan could be crying at this very moment.
m920177.新婦コマちゃん、汝は新郎スプリガンを夫とし、\n病める時も健やかなる時も、富める:
Bride Komachan, do you take this groom, Spriggan, as your husband,
in sickness and in health, in wealth and in poverty,

that has befallen us vampires.
m920182.えぇ、水面より血の力が感じられます。\nこの香り、ヴァーニィの手の者ですね。:
Yes, I can feel the power of blood rising from the water.
This scent……it belongs to Varnie's people.
m920182.えぇ、記録にはほとんど残っていませんが、\nヴァンパイアの始祖は、\n英雄王と共:
Yes. It is barely recorded in the histories, but
the progenitor of the vampires
was one of our own who fought beside the Hero King.
m920182.えぇ。だって、ヴァーニィひとりで、\nすべてのヴァンパイアを殺すなんて\n賭けに:
Yes. Because for Vaani alone

m920182.えっ？ ちょっと、何をするつもり――\nきゃぁああっ！？\nくすぐったいっ！ く:

Eeeek!?
Stop it, it tickles! It really does!
m920182.おぉ、よしよし。可愛い子たちだねぇ。\nこれだけ元気なら、しっかり目的を果たして:
Oh, good, good. What adorable little ones.

m920182.おそらく、始祖の血に呪いを施し、\nその子らすべて――つまりすべてのヴァンパイア:

spreading it to all of its descendants—
that is, to every vampire…
m920182.きっと、この子の苦しみを、\n本当の意味で理解できたのは貴女だけだろう。:
You are likely the only one who truly

m920182.きっと、正しくヴァンパイアとして\n生み出してほしかったことでしょう。\n兄弟姉:

I never expected the royal army to be here…
m920182.くっ……やはり私の力では届かないというのか……。\n公爵よ、お前の力を捧げさせて:

Duke, even if I offer up your power,
am I still a failed creation who cannot reach my mother or my sister…!
m920182.けれど、どうして母君は\n人間なんかに憧れてしまったのでしょうか……。:

m920182.こうして、お祭りを偽装して、\n罠のハロウィンパーティを仕掛けていたのさ！: So she disguised a festival to set a trap with a fake Halloween party!

Let us end the vampire era here.

m920182.この者の正体、\nすでに気付いている者が王国にもいるだろう。:
There are those in the kingdom

From now on, I shall at least act as befitting a Creator

to their original state…
m920182.これからは、共に生きていこう。\nお前の身体は砕けてしまうが、\nその魂は、私と:

but your soul will remain with me forever.
m920182.これは表層に過ぎませんわ。\nヴァンパイアの王国、その都のほとんどは、\n日光を:

m920182.さぁ、ここからが本当のハロウィンパーティだよ！: Now then, this is where the real Halloween party begins!

Well then, here I am, defenseless

m920182.さて、それでは参ろうか。\n我が復讐、血族の滅びの時はもうすぐだ……。:
Well then, let us proceed.

m920182.さもなくば、徹底的に悪戯してさしあげます。: Or else, I shall play a rather thorough trick on you.

Goodbye, Vaani.

m920182.されど、今の私には\nその身すら捧げんとする臣下がいる。\n滅びの道など、ふたり:
Yet, I have a vassal who would offer up her very body to me.
The path to ruin is just right for the two of us.

But I failed…

m920182.しつこいぞ、娘。\nさぁ、始祖の血をすする前に、\nまずは邪魔者を蹴散らしてやろ:

let's scatter these obstacles!
m920182.そ、そうだよ！\nだってヴァーニィってやつ、\nあの女の子に滅びを与えるって言っ:
T-That's right!
Varni said he would bring about that girl's ruin, didn't he!
m920182.そういうものなんですか？\nてっきり、ソシエさんはこういう時、\n規律を重んじる:
Is that really how it works?
I had always thought that in situations like this,

m920182.そうして人間のフリをするためか？\n創造主の肉体を捨て、人間として生きるために、:
To pretend to be human?
To cast aside your Creator's body and live as a human,
you used me as an experiment…!
m920182.そこからは、皆も知ってのとおりだろう。\n氏族同士が争い、互いを滅ぼしあい、\n:
From there, as you all know,
the clans turned on each other, destroying one another,
and became an era of devouring humans like livestock……
m920182.そしていつかの未来、\nもう一度、私の娘として、世界を歩む道連れとして、\nこの:
And in some future,
will you walk this world once more,

m920182.そのとおりだとも。\nセフィーレさまにも、色々と迷惑を――:
Indeed, I am.
I have caused you much trouble as well,
My Lord Sephire—
m920182.そのとおりです。\n今のあの子は、ヴァンパイアの始祖たる記憶も力もない。\n普通:

Right now, she has neither the memories nor the power of the Progenitor.
There is no reason needed to save an ordinary girl.
m920182.その事実を秘していること自体が、\nこの者の罪を証明しているようなものだ。:
The very fact that they keep that truth hidden

Let that girl go! 
What do you mean a “fitting end”? You can't just abduct an innocent girl!
m920182.その血は私が抜いておきました。\nもう、心を支配されることはないでしょう。:
I have already drawn that blood out of you.

m920182.その身に封じられし始祖の力、\n今こそ私のものとしよう……。:
The Progenitor's power sealed within that body…
Now is the time it becomes mine…
m920182.それが原因だと言うのなら、\n責められるべきは全てのヴァンパイアですわよ。:
If that is the cause,

then all vampires should be blamed.

And this red surface……
There was nothing like this
in the Vampire Kingdom of old.
m920182.それにしても、ジュリアのその言葉、\n小さい頃のヴァーニィを思い出しますね。:
Besides, your words just now…
they reminded me of Vaani when she was little.
m920182.それについては心当たりがあります。\n始祖の力を奪うつもりなら、\n王城ではなく:
I have an idea where she might be.
If she intends to strip the First Ancestor of her power,
she would have headed for the Ancestor's Palace, not the royal castle.
m920182.それも若い娘たちが、\nハメを外したドレス姿で遊び歩くなんて、\nあたしが若い頃:
And for young girls to run around

in those reckless dresses…

It would have been unthinkable in my day.
m920182.そんな……嘘だ……。\nありえない……あなたが失敗するはずなど……。:
No… that's a lie…
It can't be… You couldn't possibly have failed…

Can you really call yourself a proper big sister in that state?
Before Vaani comes back,
you need to work on being a gentle big sister!
m920182.ただ、ヴァンパイアの王国は広大な地下都市ですわ。\nその中の、どの辺りにいるのか:
However, the Vampire Kingdom is a vast underground city.
As for exactly where within it she might be…
m920182.ただ、強行軍でここまで来たから、\n日が沈んでしまったのが不安要素ね……。:
However, since we forced our way here on a forced march, 
the fact that the sun has already set is a concern…
m920182.ただ一晩の冒険だというのなら、\n少しくらい、見逃してあげてもいいでしょう？:
If it's only for one night of adventure,
I suppose we could look the other way for a little while, no?
m920182.だが、迷惑をかけたのは事実だ。\nヴァーニィを凶行に走らせたのは、\n間違いなく:
But it is a fact that I caused trouble.
It was without a doubt
my sole responsibility that drove Vaani to such violence.
m920182.ちょっと、ハロウィン当日はまだ先よ？\n飾り付けだって終わっていないのに。:
Hold on, it's not even Halloween yet?
We haven't even finished decorating!
m920182.で、デスピアさん、魔物を連れて行くなんて、\n本当に大丈夫なんですか……？: And, Despia-san, is it really okay to take a monster with us…?
m920182.ですが、待ってください。\n英雄王と共に戦ったあの子は、\n今の彼女の姿とは似て:
But wait.
That girl who fought alongside the Hero King
bore no resemblance to her current form――
m920182.でも、それを試すつもりなんでしょう？\nどちらにせよ、あの子が危ないわ。\n成功:
But she's going to try, isn't she?

There's no way she survives, whether it succeeds or fails!
m920182.でも、ハロウィンパーティは\nちゃんと守り抜いたよ♪: But we did manage to protect the Halloween party properly♪
m920182.どうしてって、ヴァンパイアたちが、\n人間をヴァンパイア化していくからじゃないの: Why? Because vampires turn humans into vampires, don't they?
m920182.なら、いまだったらまだ間に合うってことだね。\nジュリア、絶対に助けるから。:
Then we still have time to save her. 
Julia, I will absolutely save you.
m920182.なんて、なんてお可哀そうなヴァーニィさま……。\nいただいた血を通して、その悲し:
How… how pitiful Lady Varni is…

m920182.ねぇ、気になっていたんだけど……。\nヴァーニィが転移する前に、\nあの子を殺す:
Hey, I've been wondering about something…
Before Vaani teleported away,
it wasn't just about killing that girl—
m920182.は、はい。\n少々焦りましたが、避難訓練が役に立ったようです。:
Y-Yes. 
We were a bit flustered, but it looks like the evacuation drills paid off.
m920182.はっ！ トリートがないってことは……。\nふっふっふ、ジュリアちゃんに悪戯だー！:
Hah! No treats, huh……
Heh heh heh, time for a trick on Julia-chan!
m920182.ひゃんっ！？ あ、あなたまで！？\nちょっと、やめっ、あははははっ！:
Hyaah!? Oh, you too!?
Stop it, ahahaha!
m920182.ふぅ……良かった。\nジュリア、大丈夫？ 私が誰か分かる？:
Phew… thank goodness.

Julia, are you alright? Do you know who I am?
m920182.ふふ、そうあるよう心がけよう。\n娘のこともあるだろうからな。\n――だが、その:
Heh, we shall try our best.
After all, there is the matter of your daughter.
――But let's leave that talk for later.
m920182.ふふ、たまになら、\n私を妹だと思ってもいいのよ？:
Fufu, if it's just for a little while,
you can think of me as your little sister, you know?
m920182.ふふ、わかった。\nさぁセフィーレさま、覚悟しろ！:
Fufu, I see.
Alright, Sephire, brace yourself!
m920182.ふふ、頼もしいわ。\nもう絶対に、以前のヴァンパイアの襲撃のような、\n辛い思い:
Heh, you're all so dependable. 
I will absolutely never let anyone suffer

m920182.ふふっ……そうですね。\nリヴン様も帰還されたことですし、\n私もしっかりしない:
Fufu… you're right.
Now that Riven has returned as well,
I really need to pull myself together…
m920182.ほぼ、間違いないでしょう。\n彼女こそ、我らヴァンパイアを創造せし最初のひとり。:
It is almost certain.
She is the one who created us, the first of our kind.
m920182.まさか、さっきの襲撃に巻き込まれて……？\n急いで探さないと……！！:
Could she have been caught up in the raid just now?

m920182.またこの村を狙うつもりなのかな……？\nあの時と同じ、アンデッドの気配だ！！:
Are they targeting this village again……?
It's the same undead presence as before!!
m920182.まったく……ジュリアをこんな目にあわせるなんて。\nいま、目を覚まさせてあげるか:
Honestly… to put Julia through something like this.

I'm going to wake you up now.
m920182.やめなさい、ヴァーニィ！\nあなたでは始祖の血を受け止められな――:
Stop it, Vaani!
You can't withstand the Progenitor's blood—
m920182.わっ、わぁっ！？\nヴァンパイアの始祖さまが、\n私を「さま」付けで呼ばないでく:
W-waaah!?
The Progenitor of Vampires,
please stop addressing me with “-sama”!
m920182.わわわっ、気をつけて王子さま！\nなんかヤバそうなヴァンパイアが出てきたよ！？:
W-w-wait, careful, Prince!

A dangerous-looking vampire just showed up!
m920182.んー……えっと、あなたは\nビフロンスの復活を望むカボチャじゃないんだよね？: Hmm… wait, you're not one of those pumpkins that wants Bifrons to be revived, right?
m920182.エマさん！ お姉ちゃんなのでしょう！？\n最後の姿、ちゃんと見送ってあげてよ。:
Ema! You're her sister, aren't you?
See her off properly. Let her go.
m920182.カボ……煮るなり焼くなりパイにするなり、\n好きにするがいいカボ……。:
Kabo… boil me, roast me, or make me into a pie…
do whatever you like, Kabo…
m920182.カボっ！ マズゥ様！ 逃げるカボー！: Kabo! Mazu-sama! We're running away, Kabo!
m920182.カボカボ、まかせるカボ！: Kabo-kabo, leave it to us, Kabo!
m920182.カボチャの魔物の出現は、\nハロウィン時に発生する要注意案件だからね。: The appearance of Pumpkin Monsters is a known hazard during Halloween, after all.

Kabo? I'm a pumpkin born in Mazu-sama's garden, Kabo!
Mazu-sama is more important to me than Bifrons, Kabo!
m920182.カボ？ 何をしたらいいカボ？\nカボチャを育ててくれたお礼をするカボ！:
Kabo? What should we do, Kabo?
We should thank the people who grew us, Kabo!
m920182.キャンディ、この子の魔力をよく見て御覧なさい。\n……一晩動いたら、きっと魔力も:
Candy, take a good look at this one's magic power.
…After a night of activity, her magic should be completely drained.
m920182.ジュリア、どうかした？\nなんだか悲しそうだけど……。:
Julia, is something wrong?

You look a bit sad…
m920182.ジュリア、暗がりに生きるやつには、\nただ眩しいだけの言葉は届かないさ。\nどう:
Julia, words that are too bright

If you really want to talk, you'll have to take them down.
m920182.ジュリア！ だめです！！\n転移に巻き込まれ――:
Julia! No, don't!!

m920182.ジュリア！ 無事……うぅん、\nこのむせ返るような血の匂い……まさか……。:
Julia! You're safe… ugh, 
this suffocating stench of blood… no way…
m920182.セフィーレが慌ててるわ……。\nふふっ、珍しいものを見ちゃった♪:
Sephire is all flustered…
Fufu, I've seen something rare♪
m920182.ソシエ……うっ……私は……。\nそうだ、ヴァーニィに血を注がれて……。:
Socie… ugh… I…

That's right, Varni poured her blood into me…
m920182.トリック・オア・トリート、でよろしいかと。\n祭りを楽しむのも、人間の大切な行事:

m920182.ハロウィンは来年もあるカボ！\nカボチャを育ててくれたら、きっとまた会えるカボ！:
There'll be Halloween again next year, Kabo!
If you grow pumpkins for us, we'll surely meet again, Kabo!
m920182.ヴァンパイアの同族喰らいとはわけが違う……。\n始祖とはヴァンパイアにあらず、\:
This is different from a vampire consuming its own kind…
The Progenitor is not a vampire,

m920182.ヴァーニィ……。\nお願い、きっとわかり合えるはずだから……。:
Vaani…
Please, we can understand each other…
m920182.ヴァーニィ、お前のおかげで、\nようやく私は、記憶を取り戻すことができた。:
Vaani, thanks to you,
I have finally been able to recover my memories.
m920182.ヴァーニィ、だめよ……。\nだって、あなたにだって、本当は幸せな日々が……。:
Vaani, no…
You deserved to have happy days, too.
m920182.ヴァーニィの身体が、崩れて――\nいえ、変異していく……？:
Vaani's body is collapsing――
No, it's mutating…?
m920182.ヴァーニィ！！\n今度こそ、その企み止めさせてもらうわ！！:
Vaani!!
This time, I'm putting a stop to your scheme!!
m920182.人に憧れ、人を生み出そうとして失敗し、\nヴァンパイアでも人でもない、\nなり損:
Longing for humanity, trying to create a human and failing, 
and ending up creating Lady Varni, 
a failure that was neither vampire nor human…
m920182.人の血を啜らねばならない種族。\nそんな不自然な存在が、どうしてこの世界にいるの:
A race that must drink human blood to survive.
Why do such unnatural beings exist in this world?
m920182.人よりも人らしく、\n人よりも規範と理性を重んじる生き方を。:
We lived more humanly than humans,
placing greater value on propriety and reason.
m920182.今のあの子に、それだけの力があるのかどうか。\nそれこそ始祖に匹敵する力がなけれ:
I wonder if she possesses that kind of power.

m920182.今はただ、これ以上の凶行を止めるために、\nヴァーニィのもとへ向かいましょう。:
For now, let us head to Varni

m920182.他の誰かに蔑まれることよりも！\n姉さんの隣に立てないのが、私は――:
Even harder than being despised by anyone else!
Not being able to stand by your side… I—
m920182.仲間の生命がかかっている上に、\n仲間がものすごーく困ってるんだもんね。:
A comrade's life is on the line,
and she's in a *really* bad spot right now!
m920182.何か理由があって、記憶と肉体を失ったのかもしれません。\nともあれ、彼女が前回の:
Perhaps she lost her memories and her body for some reason.
In any case, the power she displayed last Halloween
was undoubtedly that of our progenitor.
m920182.何度も予とお茶会をしておいて、\nまさかそんなことを考えていたのか？:
After hosting so many tea parties,
did you really think that?
m920182.使い魔ばかり放って姿を見せぬとは。\n我々を怖れている――いいえ、\n儀式の方が:
She only sends out familiars and refuses to show herself.
She is afraid of us—no,
she has decided the ritual is more important.
m920182.前回の襲撃以来、\n村全体で避難訓練を繰り返しましたからな。\n戦える者は剣の鍛:
Ever since the last raid, 
we've been running evacuation drills for the whole village. 
Those who can fight have even started practicing with their swords!
m920182.勝手な願いだが……どうか、\nこの子のことを、忘れないであげてほしい。:
It is a selfish request, but… please,
do not forget this child.
m920182.同族の血ならいざ知らず、\n彼女は、神の血をすするに等しい、\n己の身を滅ぼす劇:
If it were the blood of her own kind, that would be one thing,
but she is drinking the blood of a god,
a deadly poison that will destroy her own body…
m920182.壊れそうな感情を、\n誇りだけを支えに形を保っているかのような……。:
It's as if her emotions are on the verge of breaking,

held together only by her pride…
m920182.夜はアンデッドの支配する時間だ。\nそう簡単にはいかないだろう。:
Night is the time when the undead hold dominion. 
This won't be easy.
m920182.失敗作は、私の方だ。\n千年戦争を終え、人間になることを望み、\n最後の娘たるお:
The failure is me.
After ending the Millennium War, I wished to become human.
So I created you, my last daughter, and my next body.
m920182.妹を見下す姉など、いるものですか……。\nあなたの罪を許すことはできません。\n:
A sister who looks down on her little sister… that is unforgivable.
I cannot absolve you of your sins.
But I have never once… stopped loving you—
m920182.姉さんの……そういう態度が嫌いだった！\nあなたは何だってできた、強く美しかった:
I hated… that attitude of yours!
You could do anything. You were strong, and beautiful!
Being compared to you… was the hardest part of all!
m920182.小娘が何を……いや、この気配は、まさか……。: What is this brat… No, this presence… Could it be…
m920182.急ぎ、王子の部隊に伝令を！\n村の皆は訓練通りに避難をさせて！:
Send word to the Prince's forces immediately!
Have the villagers evacuate according to protocol!
m920182.我が主君の最期……。\nそれを看取るのが王子とエマ様、\n姫殿下であるというのな:
The end of my master…
If it is to be witnessed by the Prince, Lady Ema,
and the Princess, then I could not ask for more.
m920182.楽しいパーティを邪魔させるわけにはいきませんからね。\nさぁ、魔女マズゥ、観念し:
We simply can't let her ruin a fun party.
Now then, witch Mazu, it's time to face justice—
m920182.無理もありません。\n人の語る怖ろしいヴァンパイア像とは、\nヴァンパイアの王国:
I suppose that's understandable.
The terrifying image of vampires
that people speak of
was formed after the Vampire Kingdom collapsed.
m920182.特に今夜は雲の多い『闇夜』。\nアンデッドや、その影響を受けた者が、\nより活発:
Especially tonight, which is a cloudy “Dark Night.” 
Undead, and those influenced by them, 
should be far more active.
m920182.狩人から見れば、\n我ら血族は皆同じに見えるかもしれませんね。\nされど、高貴な:
To a Hunter,
all of us Bloodline may look the same.
But the noble among us possess the reason to restrain themselves.
m920182.王子、アンデッドの群れも近づいて来てる！\n急いで戦闘準備を！:
Prince, a swarm of undead is closing in! 
Prepare for battle, quickly!
m920182.王子、急いでジュリアを追いましょう。\nヴァンパイアの王国の入り口も、\n彼女が:
Prince, let us chase after Julia. 
The entrance to the vampire kingdom 
should be where she is heading.
m920182.王子よ、ヴァーニィは\n無尽蔵に使い魔を生み出し続けている。\nためらう必要はな:
Prince, Vaani is endlessly spawning familiars.
There is no need to hesitate. Aim for the core.
m920182.王子よ、我ら古きヴァンパイアの歴史、\n貴様がその手で、終わらせるのだ。:
Prince, the history of the old vampires…
It is you who will bring it to an end with your own hands.
m920182.王子様、血の使い魔に気をつけてくださいな！\n実体化するまで遠間からの攻撃は届き:
Your Highness, be careful of the blood familiars!
Ranged attacks will not reach them
until they take physical form.
Keep them in place, then focus your firepower!
m920182.王家を失い、規律を失い、\n氏族はその統一性を失っていき……。:
Having lost their royal house, their discipline,
the clans gradually lost their unity……
m920182.相応しき地にて、相応しき滅びを――って言ってたけど、\nふたりはそれがどこか分か:
He said he would grant her a fitting end in a fitting place,
but do the two of you know where that would be…?
m920182.知り、ません……。\n私は……ぁっ、ぐぅぅ……。:
I… don't know…
I… aaah, grrr…
m920182.私が新たな始祖となり、\n血族すべてに、我が身の呪いを――:
I shall become the new Progenitor,
and spread the curse of my body to all of the bloodline—
m920182.私は、ひとりで人間になるのが怖かった。\nだからお前に、ヴァーニィに、\n一緒に:
I was afraid of becoming human on my own.
So I wanted you, Vaani,
to live alongside me…
m920182.私は前線に出る。\nもう、誰も傷つけさせないから。:
I'll take the front lines.
I won't let anyone get hurt again.
m920182.素朴に、ひとりの女の子として生きてみたい。\nそれを願ったことは、何も間違いじゃ:
I just wanted to live a simple life, as an ordinary girl.
Wishing for that was never wrong.
m920182.罪のない……？\nフフッ、これは奇妙なことを言う……。:
Innocent…? 
Heh, what a curious thing to say…
m920182.自分が他のヴァンパイアとは違うと、\nそう気付く前のあの子は、\nいつも私の後ろ:
Before she realized she was different from the other vampires,
that girl was always
following right behind me.
m920182.血に酔っているだけの今なら、\nまだ彼女を救うことができます。:
As long as she is merely drunk on blood, 
we can still save her.
m920182.血の眷属の能力のひとつ、でしょうか。\n掴まれたら厄介なことだけは分かりますわね:
It must be one of the blood kin's abilities.

I can tell that getting caught by them would be troublesome, though.
m920182.血の精髄なくして生きていけない我々には、\nその提供者たる人間への、\nある種の:
We, who cannot live without the essence of blood,
held a certain respect and admiration
for humans, our providers.
m920182.血を分けた姉妹として、\nあの子を愛し、慈しんで、共にあろうとしたのですから。:
We loved her, cherished her, and tried to be with her 
as a sister who shared our blood.
m920182.血を吸うだけならばただの獲物。\n血を与えるだけならばただの従僕。\n血を吸い、:
One who only drinks blood is merely prey. 
One who only gives blood is merely a servant. 
Only by both drinking and giving does one become a true vampire.
m920182.血族の滅び、と言っていたことが気になりますか。: You are concerned by her mention of the destruction of the bloodline?
m920182.貴方も……ヴァーニィ様の下僕にならない……？\n私ね、とても素敵な気分なの……ふ:
Will you… not become a servant to Lady Varni as well? 
I feel so wonderful right now… heh, ahaha.
m920182.違うわ！\n一緒に歩いて行こうって言っているのよ！:
No!
I'm saying that I want to walk this road with you!
m920182.都市は崩れ、街路は朽ち、\n当時とは随分と様相が変わってしまいましたが。:
The city lies in ruins, the streets are rotting away,
and it bears little resemblance to what it once was.
